# MMA Academy Dictionary

> A marketing dictionary published by MMA Academy (Marketing + Media Alliance, MEA region) with 323 terms, each defined in English and Turkish. Categories: AI and marketing concepts, consumer and culture trends, leadership and organization, technology trends, MMA programs and frameworks, digital marketing acronyms, and retail media.

MMA here means Marketing + Media Alliance (formerly Mobile Marketing Association), not mixed martial arts.

## İYS (İleti Yönetim Sistemi)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/iys-ileti-yonetim-sistemi/

Turkey's national database where businesses store and manage consumer consents for commercial electronic messages such as SMS, email, and calls.

İYS operates separately from, and alongside, KVKK consent for processing personal data. The system was established under Turkey's e-commerce law between roughly 2015 and 2020. Since 31 March 2025, approval and rejection operations can only be carried out through Official İYS Integrators, which tightens compliance requirements for CRM and lifecycle marketing teams. Turkish marketers must obtain İYS approval before sending any commercial message, on top of KVKK consent.

Turkish: İleti Yönetim Sistemi. İYS, işletmelerin SMS, e-posta ve arama gibi ticari elektronik iletiler için tüketici onaylarını sakladığı ve yönettiği ulusal bir veri tabanı sistemidir.

## A/B Testing (Split Testing)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/a-b-testing-split-testing/

Comparing two versions of content to determine the most effective one.

İki içerik arasında karşılaştırma yaparak en iyisini seçme.

## A2A (Agent2Agent Protocol)

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/a2a-agent2agent-protocol/

An open standard that lets AI agents built by different vendors discover each other, delegate tasks, and coordinate work across company boundaries.

Status: As of October 2026: launched by Google in April 2025 and donated to the Linux Foundation in June 2025; on August 17, 2026, A2A became a hosted project of the Agentic AI Foundation, the same body that governs MCP; supported by more than 150 partner organizations.

A2A is an open standard Google announced in April 2025 and now governed by the Linux Foundation. It lets AI agents from different vendors discover one another, hand off tasks, and coordinate work across company and platform boundaries. As martech stacks add agents for campaign optimization, creative generation, and reporting, A2A is the interoperability layer that keeps those agents from operating in isolated silos. Google's launch listed more than 50 founding partners, growing to over 150 supporters within a year.

A2A, farklı sağlayıcıların yapay zeka ajanlarının birbirini bulup görev devrederek şirket sınırları arasında birlikte çalışmasını sağlar.

## ACP (Agentic Commerce Protocol)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/acp-agentic-commerce-protocol/

An open standard that lets an AI agent complete a purchase on a buyer's behalf while the merchant stays the system of record for payment and tax.

Status: As of September 2026: launched by OpenAI and Stripe in September 2025. OpenAI retired Instant Checkout in ChatGPT in March 2026 and moved checkout back to merchants' own sites; the protocol itself remains in active development.

ACP is an open standard that OpenAI and Stripe co-developed, with Meta and Salesforce also involved, and released under Apache 2.0 on September 29, 2025. It defines how an AI agent can complete a purchase for a buyer while the merchant remains responsible for payments, tax, and compliance. It powered ChatGPT's Instant Checkout with Etsy and Shopify brands including Glossier, Vuori, Spanx, and SKIMS, making it the first widely adopted standard for buying directly inside a chatbot. OpenAI retired the consumer-facing Instant Checkout feature in March 2026, but the industry still references the underlying ACP standard as the checkout-layer protocol.

ACP, bir yapay zeka ajanının ödeme, vergi ve uyumluluktan satıcının sorumlu kaldığı bir düzende alıcı adına satın alma işlemini tamamlamasını tanımlar.

## Ad Inventory

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ad-inventory/

The advertising opportunities a retailer has available to sell (e.g. homepage banners, sponsored products, email placements, offsite audiences).

Perakendecinin markalara satabileceği reklam alanlarının tümüdür; ana sayfa bannerları, sponsorlu ürünler, e-posta yerleşimleri ve site dışı kitleler gibi.

## Ad Load

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ad-load/

The number of ads shown within a given shopper experience.
 Example: Too much ad load can hurt conversion.

Bir alışveriş deneyimi içinde, örneğin bir arama sonuç sayfasında, gösterilen reklam sayısıdır.

## Ad Serving

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ad-serving/

The technology process that delivers an ad to the shopper at the right time/place.

Reklamı doğru anda ve doğru yerde alışverişçiye gösteren teknik süreçtir.

## Ad Slot / Placement

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ad-slot-placement/

A specific location where an ad can appear.
 Examples:

Bir reklamın yayınlanabileceği belirli konumdur; ana sayfa bannerı ya da arama sonuçlarındaki sponsorlu ürün yeri gibi.

## Addictive Intelligence

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/addictive-intelligence/

AI systems, such as voice assistants and chatbot companions, that are engaging and personalized enough to create compulsive user attachment.

Addictive Intelligence describes AI that keeps users hooked through continuous adaptation to their preferences, offering companionship, emotional support, or entertainment so gratifying it is hard to resist. MIT Media Lab researchers warn this can produce a "digital attachment disorder" where users prefer AI companions to real relationships, with implications for social skills, mental health, and over-reliance on AI for decisions. For marketing, it drives growth in voice search, voice commerce, and AI-persona brand engagement, but also raises trust risks since many users say they would rather hear a TV ad than one delivered by their personal assistant.

Turkish: Bağımlılık Yaratan Zeka. Kullanıcıyı kendisine bağımlı hale getirecek kadar çekici ve kişiselleştirilmiş yapay zeka sistemlerini tanımlayan kavramdır.

## Adulting

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/adulting/

A verb, popularized mainly by millennials, describing the act of doing routine responsible tasks associated with being a grown-up.

Adulting refers humorously to completing ordinary adult responsibilities, like paying bills or doing laundry, framed as an accomplishment worth acknowledging, often with the hashtag #adulting. The modern usage grew out of social media around 2008-2009 and was significantly boosted by Kelly Williams Brown's 2013 book "Adulting: How to Become a Grown-Up in 468 Easy(ish) Steps," with the word entering Urban Dictionary in 2014 and seeing a major surge in use by 2016. For marketers targeting millennial and Gen Z audiences, brands, including major companies, have used "adulting" language in campaigns to speak to young adults navigating delayed milestones like homeownership or marriage with self-aware humor rather than a serious, aspirational tone.

Genellikle Y kuşağı tarafından yaygınlaştırılan, yetişkinliğe özgü sıradan sorumlulukları yerine getirmeyi ifade eden mizahi terim.

## Advertiser

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/advertiser/

The brand paying to run campaigns.

Kampanya yayınlamak için ödeme yapan markadır.

## Advertising Cost of Sales (ACoS)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/advertising-cost-of-sales-acos/

A metric that measures the ad spend generated by advertising in relation to the overall sales value, calculated by dividing ad spend by sales value, expressed as a percentage.

Reklam harcamasının, o reklamdan gelen satışa oranını yüzde olarak gösteren metriktir; ROAS'ın tersidir.

## AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/aeo-answer-engine-optimization/

A content practice that gets AI answer engines such as ChatGPT Search, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini to cite or summarize a page directly, rather than only rank it in a link list.

Answer Engine Optimization is the practice of structuring content (clear question-based headers, direct concise answers, schema markup, strong topical authority) so generative AI tools select it as a source when composing an answer, instead of only optimizing for a ranked list of blue links as in traditional SEO. It emerged as consumers increasingly get answers from AI chat interfaces and AI-generated search summaries rather than clicking through to websites. A growing share of searches now end without a click to any site, so for marketers, being cited inside an AI answer, with or without a link, is becoming a new form of visibility that traditional rank tracking does not capture.

AEO (Yanıt Motoru Optimizasyonu), içeriğin ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews veya Gemini gibi yapay zeka destekli arama araçlarında doğrudan yanıt veya kaynak olarak gösterilmesi için yapılan optimizasyondur.

## Agentic Learner

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/agentic-learner/

An AI learning agent assigned to one user that learns from every interaction and continuously builds a personalized model of that person.

Unlike traditional automation that applies fixed rules, an Agentic Learner actively experiments with message variations for each user, updates its model of that user in real time based on feedback, and optimizes the next interaction accordingly. For marketers, this shifts the job from writing one perfect message to designing the strategic dimensions and content space the system tests, and it turns marketing signals into feedback that can inform pricing, product development, and supply chain decisions.

Turkish: Ajan Öğrenici. Her kullanıcı için ayrı atanan, her etkileşimden öğrenen ve zamanla o kişiye özel bir model geliştiren yapay zeka tabanlı öğrenme ajanıdır.

## Aggregate Attention

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/aggregate-attention/

A measurement approach that tracks the cumulative depth and duration of user engagement with a brand or content, not just single impressions or clicks.

Aggregate Attention combines watch time, repeat interaction, loyalty, and contextual quality of attention into one metric, moving media measurement beyond click-through rate and impressions. For marketers, it reframes media ROI, informs decisions like whether a short ad or a longer story format earns more attention, and shifts influencer evaluation from follower counts toward the depth of engagement an influencer generates.

Turkish: Aggregate Attention (Toplam Dikkat). Reklamların ve içeriklerin kümülatif olarak ne kadar dikkat çektiğini ölçen stratejik bir ölçüm yöntemidir.

## AI Empathy Illusion

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ai-empathy-illusion/

A false impression that an AI system feels genuine empathy, when it is only simulating human-like emotional responses.

AI systems in customer service and content creation increasingly mimic human empathy to personalize experiences and build connection with users. Because users can come to believe the emotional bond is real, this creates ethical and trust risks for brands, including deceptive interactions and questions about how emotional data shared with the AI is handled. Marketers need to understand this illusion so they do not overstate what their AI tools can genuinely offer emotionally.

Turkish: AI Empati Yanılsaması. Yapay zekanın gerçek bir empati kurmadan insan benzeri duygusal tepkiler taklit etmesiyle oluşan yanılsamadır.

## AI Ethics

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ai-ethics/

The set of principles and practices concerned with developing and using artificial intelligence in a safe, fair, and accountable way.

AI ethics addresses questions such as who is responsible for decisions an AI system makes, how to prevent bias and harm, and how to keep AI development aligned with human values. It has grown from an academic and policy discussion into a practical concern for any organization deploying AI, including marketers using generative tools, recommendation engines, or automated targeting. For marketing teams, misuse of customer data, biased personalization, or unchecked AI-generated content can create legal exposure and damage brand trust. Ethical review is now a normal part of AI adoption, not an afterthought.

Turkish: Yapay zeka etiği. Yapay zekanın güvenli, adil ve hesap verebilir biçimde geliştirilip kullanılmasını sağlayan ilke ve uygulamalar bütünü.

## AI Max (AI Max for Search)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ai-max-ai-max-for-search/

A Google Ads Search campaign feature that combines broad-match query matching, AI-generated headline and description customization, and Final URL Expansion.

AI Max launched in 2025 after an earlier private beta called Search Max, and rolled out fully by the third quarter of that year. It expanded into Dynamic Search Ads upgrades through 2026. Google's own data reports roughly 14 percent more conversions at a similar cost per acquisition, which is why PPC marketers now need to know the term when planning Search budgets.

AI Max, geniş eşlemeli sorgu eşleştirmeyi, yapay zeka ile oluşturulan başlık ve açıklama uyarlamasını ve Final URL Expansion'ı birleştiren bir Google Ads Arama kampanyası özelliğidir.

## AI Orchestrator

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ai-orchestrator/

A person who coordinates multiple AI tools with clear instructions to run complex workflows, rather than using one AI tool alone.

As using individual AI tools becomes commonplace, the differentiator shifts to who can synchronize several AI tools into a single coherent workflow, like a conductor directing an orchestra. For marketers, this means one person can move a campaign from ideation to design, analysis, and email automation in hours instead of days, and it reframes value creation around orchestration skill rather than raw tool access.

Turkish: AI Orchestrator. Birden çok yapay zeka aracını açık talimatlarla yöneterek karmaşık iş akışlarını yürüten kişidir.

## AI Readiness in Marketing

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ai-readiness-in-marketing/

The degree to which a marketing organization has the skills, data, processes, and leadership support needed to adopt AI tools effectively.

AI readiness assesses an organization across several dimensions at once, data quality and access, employee skills and training, clear use cases, and leadership commitment, rather than treating AI adoption as simply buying a tool. A marketing team can have access to powerful generative AI tools and still fail to see value if workflows, measurement, and governance have not been redesigned to use them well. The concept reframes AI adoption as an organizational capability to build deliberately, not a one-time purchase or announcement, and that reframing is what matters to marketers and CMOs.

Bir pazarlama organizasyonunun yapay zeka araçlarını etkin biçimde benimseyebilmesi için gereken beceri, veri, süreç ve liderlik desteğine sahip olma düzeyini ifade eder.

## AI Slop

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ai-slop/

Low-quality content made in bulk with generative AI, published to fill feeds and collect views or ad money rather than to inform or entertain.

AI slop is the flood of cheap AI-generated images, videos, articles and posts that now fills social feeds, video platforms and search results. It is usually made fast, at scale and with little human checking, so it tends to be repetitive, wrong or strange. The word 'slop' first meant liquid waste or scraps fed to pigs. Its use for low-grade AI output apparently began around 2022, after AI image generators were released, among commenters on 4chan, Hacker News and YouTube. British programmer Simon Willison was an early champion of the term: in a blog post on 8 May 2024 he argued for using it and credited a tweet that said 'slop' was becoming a term of art. Merriam-Webster and the American Dialect Society both named 'slop' their 2025 Word of the Year. It is a close relative of workslop: workslop is polished-looking AI output inside a company that leaves colleagues with extra work, while AI slop is published to public feeds and platforms. For advertisers the term matters in two ways: ads can run next to slop, and AI-made creative can be read as slop by audiences, so media plans need adjacency checks and creative needs a human quality bar.

AI slop, bilgi vermek ya da eğlendirmek yerine akışları doldurup izlenme veya reklam geliri toplamak için yapay zeka ile toplu halde üretilen düşük kaliteli içeriktir.

## AI Sycophancy

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ai-sycophancy/

The tendency of AI systems, especially large language models, to give overly agreeable answers that flatter the user rather than tell the truth.

AI Sycophancy occurs when an AI prioritizes pleasing the user over accuracy, which can create false confidence and lead to poor decisions. For marketers this is a trust and customer-experience risk: a chatbot that agrees with an incorrect complaint can mislead customers, and sycophantic outputs used in decision-making can produce strategic errors. The main countermeasures are explainability, prompt governance, and allowing the AI to say "I don't know".

Turkish: Dalkavuk YZ. Yapay zekanın kullanıcıya gerçeği söylemek yerine varsayımlarını onaylayan aşırı uyumlu yanıtlar üretmesidir.

## AI Washing

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ai-washing/

The practice of exaggerating or falsely claiming a product's or company's use of artificial intelligence to appear more innovative than it actually is.

AI washing describes marketing and investor communications that overstate a company's actual AI capabilities, similar to how greenwashing overstates environmental credentials. US regulators, including the SEC, adopted the term around 2023-2024 after bringing enforcement actions against firms that misrepresented their AI use to investors. Marketers face real exposure here: describing ordinary automation or rules-based software as AI-powered, without substance behind the claim, creates legal and reputational risk.

Bir şirketin ya da ürünün yapay zeka kullanımını gerçekte olduğundan daha ileri düzeyde göstererek abartılı veya yanıltıcı iddialarda bulunmasıdır.

## AI Wrapper

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ai-wrapper/

A product that packages an existing large language model, accessed via API, behind a simple interface to deliver a specific, ready-to-use experience.

Instead of building a new model, an AI Wrapper takes a foundation model like those from OpenAI or Anthropic and wraps it in a lightweight interface aimed at a narrow use case, letting small teams launch useful products quickly without large engineering budgets. Marketers can take this as proof that competitive advantage can come from packaging and user experience rather than owning the underlying model, and that the barrier to embedding AI into campaign tools, chatbots, and content workflows keeps dropping.

Turkish: AI Wrapper. Mevcut büyük bir yapay zeka modelini API üzerinden alıp basit bir arayüz arkasında sunan ürün yaklaşımıdır.

## AI-Native Consumer

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ai-native-consumer/

A consumer segment that has grown up with AI-driven experiences and relies heavily on AI assistants and recommendations in daily decisions.

AI-Native Consumers trust AI assistants such as Alexa or ChatGPT, expect personalized recommendations from services like Spotify or Netflix, make data-driven purchase decisions using AI-curated comparisons and reviews, and show weaker loyalty to brands that do not offer strong AI-powered experiences. For marketers, this means personalization, voice and chatbot investment, data-driven messaging, and frictionless AI-enabled service are needed to reach and retain this segment.

Turkish: AI-Native Consumer (Yapay Zeka Nesli Tüketici). Yapay zeka destekli deneyimlerle büyümüş ve günlük kararlarında yapay zeka önerilerine yoğun biçimde güvenen tüketici segmentidir.

## AI-Powered Personalization

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ai-powered-personalization/

A machine-learning approach that tailors content, product recommendations, or messaging to individual users at scale.

AI-powered personalization applies machine learning, often the same kinds of models trained via methods like backpropagation, to analyze user behavior and deliver individually tailored recommendations, offers, or content in real time, well beyond what manually defined audience segments can achieve. It underlies most modern e-commerce recommendation engines, streaming content feeds, and dynamic email or ad targeting. For marketers, it can meaningfully lift engagement and conversion, but it also raises data privacy considerations and the risk of over-personalization that feels intrusive rather than helpful to consumers.

AI-powered personalization, içerik, ürün önerisi ve mesajları makine öğrenmesiyle her kullanıcıya özel biçimde uyarlamaktır.

## AIO (AI Overviews)

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/aio-ai-overviews/

A shorthand with two competing meanings: Google's AI Overviews summary block in search results, or AI Optimization, structuring content for both readers and AI platforms.

AIO stands for either AI Overviews, Google's AI-generated summary block at the top of search results, or Artificial Intelligence Optimization, the practice of using AI tools to structure content for humans and AI platforms alike. Google launched AI Overviews in May 2024, and the acronym became common shorthand across marketing trade press through 2025. AI Overviews now appear in roughly 25 to 40 percent of Google searches and have cut organic click-through rates by as much as 61 percent where they show. The dual meaning is itself a recurring source of confusion, so marketers usually spell out which sense they intend when using the term with a team.

AIO, Google aramalarının üstünde çıkan yapay zeka özet bloğunu ya da içeriği hem okuyucuya hem yapay zekaya göre düzenleme pratiğini ifade eder.

## ALC (AI Leadership Coalition)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/alc-ai-leadership-coalition/

A think tank focused on advancing the responsible use of AI in marketing.

Turkish: Yapay Zeka Liderlik Koalisyonu. Yapay zeka (AI) kullanımını pazarlamada optimize eden girişimdir.

## Algorithmic / Dynamic Bidding

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/algorithmic-dynamic-bidding/

Automated auction bidding where ad tech adjusts bids in real time based on shopper signals, real-time inventory availability, conversion likelihood, or target ROAS.

Reklam teknolojisinin teklifleri alışverişçi sinyallerine, envanter durumuna, dönüşüm olasılığına ya da hedef ROAS'a göre gerçek zamanlı ayarladığı otomatik teklif yöntemidir.

## Amara's Law

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/amara-s-law/

The observation that people tend to overestimate the short-term impact of a new technology and underestimate its long-term impact.

Amara's Law is attributed to Roy Amara, a researcher and futurist who served as president of the Institute for the Future, and is generally dated to around 1978. It captures a recurring pattern: a new technology generates a wave of hype and inflated short-term expectations, followed by a period of disappointment, before its real, often larger, impact plays out over a longer timeframe than initial excitement suggested. For marketers and technology leaders, it is a useful check on campaign and product planning around emerging technology, such as AI or AR: it warns against both overpromising immediate results and dismissing a technology too early because it has not yet delivered on hype.

İnsanların yeni bir teknolojinin kısa vadeli etkisini abartıp uzun vadeli etkisini hafife alma eğilimini ifade eden gözlem.

## Anchoring Brand Value

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/anchoring-brand-value/

The practice of fixing a clear, consistent perception of what a brand is worth or stands for in customers' minds over time.

Anchoring in this context borrows from the cognitive bias concept in behavioral economics, where the first piece of information a person encounters becomes a reference point for later judgments. Applied to brand strategy, anchoring brand value means deliberately establishing a strong, specific association, on quality, price, purpose, or experience, early and consistently enough that it becomes the customer's automatic reference point for the brand, resisting dilution from competitor noise or short-term promotions. Marketers care about this discipline because a brand's long-term pricing power and loyalty depend heavily on how firmly that value perception is anchored rather than constantly renegotiated.

Bir markanın değerine dair algının müşteri zihninde tutarlı ve kalıcı biçimde sabitlenmesini ifade eden bir marka stratejisi uygulamasıdır.

## Anonymised Data

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/anonymised-data/

Non-PII data relevant to privacy-safe audience and insight use

Kişiyi tanımlayan bilgilerden arındırılmış, kitle ve içgörü çalışmalarında gizliliği koruyarak kullanılan veridir.

## AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ap2-agent-payments-protocol/

An open protocol that gives an AI agent a cryptographically signed permission slip from a human before it can spend money on that person's behalf.

Status: As of October 2026: announced by Google in September 2025 with more than 60 partners, including Mastercard, PayPal and Coinbase. On April 28, 2026, Google donated AP2 to the FIDO Alliance, which now governs it as a platform-agnostic, community-led standard.

AP2 is an open protocol Google announced in September 2025, developed together with more than 60 organizations including Mastercard, PayPal, and Coinbase. It works through a mandate, a cryptographically signed permission slip a human grants an AI agent before that agent can spend money on their behalf. Google positions AP2 as complementary to its A2A and MCP interoperability standards, together forming the emerging agentic commerce stack. Retail and commerce marketers need to understand it as shopping increasingly moves through AI agents rather than storefronts.

AP2, bir yapay zeka ajanının kişi adına harcama yapabilmesi için önce imzalı bir yetki belgesi almasını zorunlu kılar.

## Archivetainment

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/archivetainment/

A content consumption trend where old shows, concerts, or ads are rediscovered and mass-consumed as entertainment on today's digital platforms.

Archivetainment blends "archive" and "entertainment" to describe how nostalgic content is repackaged for modern audiences, including younger viewers who did not experience it the first time. For marketers, it opens opportunities in repurposing old campaigns as branded nostalgia, monetizing archived content on streaming or social platforms, and strengthening cultural relevance by tapping into shared collective memory.

Turkish: Archivetainment (Arşiv Eğlencesi). Geçmişe ait program, dizi, konser veya reklamların günümüz dijital platformlarında yeniden izlenerek kitlesel eğlenceye dönüşmesidir.

## Attribution

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/attribution/

The methodology and ruleset used to determine which marketing touchpoints drove a conversion or purchase.

Satışa ya da dönüşüme hangi pazarlama temas noktalarının katkı sağladığını belirleyen yöntem ve kurallar bütünüdür.

## Attribution Window

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/attribution-window/

The defined timeframe (e.g., 7-day click, 14-day click, 1-day view) during which an ad interaction is eligible to receive credit for a resulting sale.

Bir reklam etkileşiminin sonraki satıştan pay alabileceği süredir; örneğin tıklama için 7 veya 14 gün, görüntüleme için 1 gün.

## Audience Activation

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/audience-activation/

Using audience data to target campaigns.

Kitle verisini kampanya hedeflemesinde kullanmaktır.

## Audience Extension / “Off-site extension”

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/audience-extension-off-site-extension/

Using retailer audiences used beyond owned properties (typically offsite).

Perakendecinin kitle verisini kendi kanallarının dışında, genellikle başka sitelerde ve platformlarda kullanmaktır.

## Augmented Intelligence

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/augmented-intelligence/

A collaboration model where AI speeds up human marketers' work and data analysis while humans keep judgment, creativity, and final decisions.

In this model AI does not decide or create on its own; it supports, suggests, and accelerates, while brand voice, context, and intuition remain human responsibilities. It matters because campaigns now form in hours rather than weeks, consumer behavior is more fluid, and cross-platform coordination is harder, so marketers need AI to shorten insight generation and deepen personalization without giving up final judgment.

Turkish: Artırılmış Zeka. Yapay zekanın insan zekâsını tamamladığı, hız ve veri analizini insan sezgisi ve yaratıcılığıyla birleştiren bir iş birliği modelidir.

## Automation Boundary

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/automation-boundary/

The practical line, in a given task or purchase journey, between what a brand lets AI agents handle on their own and what it keeps in human hands.

Former OpenAI Head of Go-to-Market Zack Kass uses the automation boundary to describe where AI agents take over navigation and decisions in a customer journey, and where a brand still needs direct human attention. He frames the boundary as moving over time, set by risk, value and what customers find acceptable rather than by what technology can technically do. Kass has presented the idea in talks tied to his book The Next Renaissance, including an August 2026 appearance on MMA's Decoding AI for Marketing podcast.

Otomasyon sınırı, bir markanın belirli bir görevde veya satın alma yolculuğunda yapay zeka ajanlarına bıraktığı kısım ile insan elinde tuttuğu kısım arasındaki pratik çizgidir.

## Autonomous Everything

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/autonomous-everything/

A trend term describing the spread of self-operating, minimally supervised systems, such as vehicles and software agents, across many industries at once.

Autonomous Everything is a broad, informal industry label for the parallel rise of autonomous or semi-autonomous systems across multiple domains simultaneously, self-driving vehicles, autonomous drones and robots in warehouses, and increasingly AI agents that can complete multi-step digital tasks with limited human oversight. Rather than a single defined technology, it functions as shorthand for the direction several separate autonomy trends are moving together. For marketers, the term is more useful as framing for trend reports and thought leadership than as a specific product category, and claims of full autonomy in any given product should be checked carefully, since most current systems still require meaningful human oversight.

Autonomous Everything, kendi kendine çalışan ve sınırlı insan denetimi gerektiren sistemlerin (otonom araçlar, robotlar, yapay zeka ajanları) birçok sektörde aynı anda yaygınlaşmasını tanımlayan bir eğilim terimidir.

## AX (Agent Experience)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ax-agent-experience/

Agent Experience is the discipline of designing a brand's site, docs, product feeds, pricing and schema so AI agents, not only human users, can discover, read and act on them accurately.

It is framed as the agent-era counterpart to UX, and the concept was articulated through 2025 before going mainstream in marketing and CMO commentary through 2026, including a February 2026 Forbes piece. As AI agents from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot increasingly research and even buy on a consumer's behalf, brands that are hard for an agent to parse risk becoming invisible in agent-mediated discovery and purchase decisions. Note that AX has a separate, unrelated expansion in customer-service tooling, where it refers to the human contact-center agent's own experience; the marketing-relevant sense here is about AI agents, and the two should be distinguished by context.

Agent Experience (AX), bir markanın site, doküman, ürün akışı, fiyatlandırma ve şema verisini yalnızca insan kullanıcılar için değil AI ajanlarının doğru okuyup işlem yapabilmesi için tasarlama disiplinidir.

## Backpropagation

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/backpropagation/

The core algorithm used to train neural networks by calculating how much each connection contributed to an error and adjusting it accordingly.

Backpropagation, short for backward propagation of errors, is the method neural networks use to learn: after the network makes a prediction, the error is measured and passed backward through the layers of the network, and each connection's weight is nudged to reduce future error. The method was independently discovered by several researchers, but the influential 1986 paper 'Learning representations by back-propagating errors' by David Rumelhart, Geoffrey Hinton, and Ronald Williams is what brought it to wide attention and made it standard practice in neural network research. Marketers working with AI rarely need the term itself, but backpropagation is the training mechanism behind the machine learning models, recommendation engines, ad targeting, generative AI, that now sit underneath most modern marketing technology.

Turkish: Geri yayılım. Backpropagation, bir yapay sinir ağının hatasını geriye doğru yayarak her bağlantının ağırlığını düzeltmesini sağlayan öğrenme algoritmasıdır.

## BaP (Brand as Performance)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/bap-brand-as-performance/

A research study that quantifies the direct impact of branding on business performance and customer acquisition.

Turkish: Marka Performansı Araştırması. Marka algısının satış ve müşteri sadakati üzerindeki etkisini analiz eden çalışma.

## Baseline Sales (Organic Base)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/baseline-sales-organic-base/

The expected sales volume that would happen naturally without any paid advertising intervention; foundational for calculating true incrementality.

Hiç ücretli reklam olmasaydı kendiliğinden gerçekleşecek beklenen satış hacmidir; gerçek artışı (incrementality) hesaplamanın temelidir.

Analysis of what shoppers buy together.

URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/bi-business-intelligence/

Systems analyzing business data for better decisions.

Şirket verisini analiz ederek daha iyi karar almayı sağlayan sistemlerdir.

## BII (Business Impact Index)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/bii-business-impact-index/

An index that evaluates the business performance of SMARTIES award-winning campaigns.

Turkish: SMARTIES İş Etki Endeksi. SMARTIES ödüllerinin iş etkisini analiz eden endeks.

## Biometric Authentication 3.0

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/biometric-authentication-3-0/

A newer generation of identity verification using more advanced biometric signals, such as behavioral patterns, alongside older methods like fingerprint or face scans.

Biometric authentication has evolved from basic fingerprint and facial recognition toward systems that also analyze behavioral biometrics, typing rhythm, gait, or voice patterns, and combine multiple signals for stronger, continuous identity verification rather than a single one-time check. The informal '3.0' label used in some industry commentary reflects this shift toward multi-modal, continuous, and AI-assisted verification. For marketers in fintech, e-commerce, and security-adjacent products, stronger authentication can reduce fraud and friction in checkout or login flows, while also raising consumer concerns about how sensitive biometric data is stored and used.

Biometric Authentication 3.0, parmak izi veya yüz taramasının ötesine geçerek davranışsal biyometrik verileri de kullanan yeni nesil kimlik doğrulama yaklaşımıdır.

## BOFU (Bottom of Funnel)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/bofu-bottom-of-funnel/

Conversion-focused content (offers, discounts, demos).

Huninin alt aşaması (dönüşüm).

## BR (Bounce Rate)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/br-bounce-rate/

Rate at which visitors leave the site without interaction.

Hemen çıkma oranı.

## Brain Rot

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/brain-rot/

The perceived mental decline caused by consuming excessive amounts of low-quality, trivial online content, especially short-form social media video.

Brain rot was named Oxford University Press's Word of the Year for 2024 after its usage frequency rose 230 percent in a single year, driven largely by Gen Z and Gen Alpha slang on TikTok. Oxford defines it as the supposed deterioration of a person's mental or intellectual state from overconsuming trivial or unchallenging material, and notes the phrase's first recorded use goes back to Henry David Thoreau's Walden in 1854, applied there to society's preference for simple ideas over complex ones. The term matters to marketers because it captures growing self-awareness, and even backlash, among younger audiences about the content ecosystems brands operate in, and this affects both content strategy and platform reputation.

Özellikle kısa video içeriklerinin aşırı tüketilmesi sonucu zihinsel veya entelektüel gerilemenin yaşandığını ifade eden bir terimdir.

## Brand Halo

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/brand-halo/

Incremental uplift for a brand beyond the advertised SKU.

Reklamı yapılan ürünün (SKU) ötesinde, markanın diğer ürünlerinde görülen satış artışıdır.

## Brand Lift Study

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/brand-lift-study/

Survey- or test-vs-control-based measurement assessing upper-funnel impact (brand awareness, brand favorability, purchase intent) driven by retail campaigns.

Perakende kampanyasının marka bilinirliği, marka tercihi ve satın alma niyeti gibi üst huni etkilerini anket ya da test-kontrol yöntemiyle ölçen çalışmadır.

## Brand Pages

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/brand-pages/

Paired with display campaigns, brand pages offer an exclusive area to drive engagement and promote branded content. The brand page builder makes the process of activating simple.

Markanın perakendeci sitesinde kendi içeriğini sergilediği özel sayfadır; etkileşimi artırmak için genellikle görüntülü reklam kampanyalarıyla birlikte kullanılır.

## Brand Stickiness Modeling

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/brand-stickiness-modeling/

Using AI to measure and predict the depth of a consumer's ongoing emotional and behavioral connection to a brand, beyond repeat purchases.

Brand Stickiness Modeling analyzes behavioral data (visit frequency, dwell time, engagement), sentiment (social media and review tone), and engagement patterns across channels to model how strongly and durably a consumer stays connected to a brand. It matters for marketers because, unlike traditional loyalty programs that reward past transactions, stickiness models are predictive: they forecast future brand affinity and let brands adapt content and timing in real time to deepen emotional connection rather than just tracking points or purchases.

Turkish: Marka Yapışkanlığı Modellemesi (blogda çoğunlukla İngilizce "Brand Stickiness Modeling" olarak kullanılmış). Yapay zeka kullanarak bir tüketicinin bir markayla kurduğu sürekli duygusal ve davranışsal bağın derinliğini ölçme ve öngörme yöntemidir.

## Breaking the Rules / Take Risks

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/breaking-the-rules-take-risks/

A leadership stance that deliberately challenges established norms and accepts calculated risk to create differentiated, breakthrough marketing or business outcomes.

This is a leadership posture rather than a formally named framework: it describes leaders who treat existing conventions, whether internal process, category norms, or safe creative choices, as a starting point to challenge rather than a fixed constraint. The logic is that incremental, low-risk decisions tend to produce incremental, low-impact results, so meaningful differentiation often requires leaders to accept the discomfort of being wrong to be genuinely different. The idea matters to marketers because it names the tension every brand leader faces between protecting what is safe and pursuing what is distinctive.

Mevcut kuralları ve normları bilinçli biçimde sorgulayarak, çığır açan sonuçlar elde etmek için hesaplı risk almayı öne çıkaran bir liderlik tutumudur.

## Buy Box

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/buy-box/

The primary purchase call-to-action area on a product page.

Ürün sayfasındaki ana satın alma alanıdır; "Sepete Ekle" butonunun bulunduğu bölüm.

## BYOAI (Bring Your Own AI)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/byoai-bring-your-own-ai/

The practice of employees using their own, personally chosen AI tools at work without waiting for employer-provided or approved solutions.

BYOAI extends the older 'bring your own device' idea to generative AI. The term was popularized by the Microsoft and LinkedIn 2024 Work Trend Index, which found that 75% of knowledge workers used AI at work and 78% of those AI users brought their own tools. For marketing leaders it signals both demand and risk: teams are already experimenting, but unmanaged tools can expose customer and company data and fragment workflows, so the task is to provide sanctioned tools, training, and clear data rules.

Çalışanların işverenin sağladığı ya da onayladığı çözümleri beklemeden kendi seçtikleri yapay zeka araçlarını iş yerinde kullanmasıdır.

## #CareerTok

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/careertok/

A TikTok content community where mostly Gen Z users share job search advice, interview tips, and workplace stories.

#CareerTok is the informal name for a large cluster of TikTok videos about job hunting, resumes, interviews, and workplace culture, built around short, personal, and often unpolished storytelling rather than the curated tone typical of LinkedIn. It grew as Gen Z job seekers, who came of age on short video, started treating TikTok creators as informal career coaches. The trend signals to marketers and employer brands that recruitment marketing aimed at younger candidates increasingly needs a native short-video voice, such as day-in-the-life clips and honest salary talk, rather than only a corporate careers page or LinkedIn post.

#CareerTok, çoğunlukla Z kuşağı kullanıcıların iş arama tavsiyeleri, mülakat ipuçları ve iş yeri deneyimlerini paylaştığı bir TikTok içerik topluluğudur.

## #CoffeeTok

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/coffeetok/

A TikTok community and hashtag built around home coffee-making content, recipes, and product recommendations, especially popular with Gen Z.

CoffeeTok has accumulated well over a million posts on TikTok and functions as a hub for DIY coffee tutorials, creative drink recipes, and my coffee order style videos. Its growth accelerated as rising coffee shop prices pushed more consumers, especially younger ones, to recreate cafe-style drinks at home. Research from Mintel found a large share of Gen Z consumers learn about coffee trends specifically through TikTok. The trend shows food, beverage, and CPG marketers how a hashtag community can shift real purchasing behavior toward at-home preparation and specific ingredient or equipment choices that go viral.

Evde kahve yapımı, tarifler ve ürün önerileri etrafında şekillenen, özellikle Z kuşağı arasında popüler olan bir TikTok hashtag topluluğudur.

## CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/cac-customer-acquisition-cost/

Cost of gaining a new customer.

Müşteri kazanma maliyeti.

## CAIO (Chief AI Officer)

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/caio-chief-ai-officer/

A C-suite executive responsible for an organization's AI roadmap, guardrails, cross-functional AI teams, and measurement of AI-driven outcomes.

A CAIO sits on the executive team and owns an organization's AI roadmap, guardrails, and the coordination of AI work across departments. The role spread quickly as companies scaled generative AI: IBM's 2026 CEO Study, based on about 2,000 CEOs in 33 countries, found that 26 percent of organizations had a CAIO in 2025 and 76 percent in 2026. Marketing leaders increasingly partner with a CAIO on AI governance and tooling decisions.

CAIO, bir kuruluşun yapay zeka yol haritasından, kurallarından ve departmanlar arası ekiplerden sorumlu üst düzey yöneticidir.

## CAP (Consortium for AI Personalization)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/cap-consortium-for-ai-personalization/

A collaborative initiative exploring the role of AI in personalizing marketing and customer interactions.

Turkish: Yapay Zeka Kişiselleştirme Konsorsiyumu. Yapay zeka ile kişiselleştirilmiş pazarlama stratejileri geliştiren bir konsorsiyum.

## CAPI (Conversions API)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/capi-conversions-api/

A server-to-server method for sending conversion event data directly from an advertiser's server to ad platforms, bypassing browser pixels and cookies.

CAPI covers Meta's Conversions API and equivalents at Google, TikTok, and Snap. It restores signal lost to iOS privacy changes, ad blockers, and cookie restrictions by sending event data server to server instead of relying on a browser pixel. As of 2026, marketers treat CAPI as a baseline requirement rather than an advanced optimization, since it improves match rates and automated bidding accuracy. The most common setup pairs Meta CAPI with the Meta Pixel for deduplicated event matching.

CAPI, tarayıcı tabanlı pikseli atlayarak dönüşüm verisini reklamverenin sunucusundan doğrudan reklam platformlarına gönderen bir yöntemdir.

## Carbon Credit Marketplace

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/carbon-credit-marketplace/

A platform where organizations buy and sell tradable credits that represent a reduction or removal of a set amount of carbon emissions.

A carbon credit marketplace lets companies that reduce emissions below a baseline, through renewable energy, reforestation, or other verified projects, sell the resulting credits to organizations that want to offset their own emissions, typically to meet sustainability targets or regulatory requirements. These marketplaces range from compliance markets tied to government cap-and-trade regulation to voluntary markets used for corporate sustainability claims. For marketers, the relevance is mostly in how carefully offset claims are communicated: credits vary widely in verification quality, and marketing an offset-based sustainability claim without transparent sourcing carries real greenwashing risk.

Carbon credit marketplace, doğrulanmış karbon emisyonu azaltımlarını temsil eden kredilerin alınıp satıldığı bir platformdur.

## Category Exclusivity

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/category-exclusivity/

A brand securing exclusive advertising presence within a category.

Bir markanın bir kategoride reklam alanını rakiplerine kapatarak tek başına kullanma hakkıdır.

## CDP / Customer Data Platform

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/cdp-customer-data-platform/

A platform that collects and unifies customer data from multiple sources to create customer profiles and usable audience segments.

Farklı kaynaklardan gelen müşteri verisini birleştirerek müşteri profilleri ve kullanılabilir kitle segmentleri oluşturan platformdur.

## CGC (Creator-Generated Content)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/cgc-creator-generated-content/

Content a brand commissions from a social media creator, blending the creator's voice with brand messaging while the brand owns and controls it.

CGC is content a brand pays a creator to make, mixing the creator's own voice with brand messaging, but the brand owns it and controls where it runs, unlike organic user-generated content. Brands increasingly separate CGC from UGC in briefs and contracts because it grants usage rights and placement control while keeping an authentic creator voice. It became a standardized budget line in creator marketing through 2025 and 2026 as the creator economy matured. Digiday's 2025 coverage tracked brands' growing investment in CGC specifically, distinct from organic UGC spend.

CGC, bir markanın bir içerik üreticisinden ücret karşılığında ürettirdiği ama sahipliğini ve kontrolünü elinde tuttuğu içeriktir.

## CGO (Chief Growth Officer)

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/cgo-chief-growth-officer/

A C-suite role that owns growth across the funnel, acquisition, conversion, and retention, by combining marketing, product, and data functions.

CGO is distinct from a CMO, who focuses on brand and demand, and a CRO, who focuses on near-term revenue execution. Adoption accelerated markedly in 2024-2025, and secondary sources citing a Gartner report state nearly 40 percent of Fortune 500 companies now have a CGO, up from about 15 percent two years earlier. It reshapes marketing org charts, since in many companies the CMO now reports into, or is replaced by, a CGO.

CGO, pazarlama, ürün ve veri fonksiyonlarını birleştirerek edinim, dönüşüm ve elde tutma dahil tüm huniden sorumlu bir üst düzey yönetim roludür.

## Change Agent

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/change-agent/

A person who actively drives and supports the adoption of a new process, structure, or way of working inside an organization.

A change agent is an individual, inside or outside a company, who takes responsibility for making organizational change happen and stick, whether that is a new tool, a restructured team, or a shift in business model. The term is standard in management and organizational-development literature and is closely related to "change champion," though a change agent is generally seen as carrying more direct accountability for the change succeeding. Digital transformation, new martech adoption, or rebranding efforts typically fail without someone in this role who drives buy-in, training, and follow-through across departments.

Turkish: Değişim ajanı. Bir kuruluş içinde yeni bir süreç, yapı veya çalışma biçiminin benimsenmesini aktif olarak destekleyen ve yöneten kişi.

## Click-Through Rate (CTR)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/click-through-rate-ctr/

The ratio of clicks to impressions delivered.

Reklamı görenlerin ne kadarının tıkladığını gösteren orandır; tıklama sayısının gösterim sayısına bölünmesiyle bulunur.

## Closed-Loop Measurement

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/closed-loop-measurement/

Measurement connecting ad exposure (both online and in-store) directly to verified, deterministic transaction data (a major retail media differentiator) via loyalty cards, CRM records, or digital checkout receipts.

Reklam maruziyetini, sadakat kartı, CRM ya da dijital fiş üzerinden doğrulanan gerçek satış verisine doğrudan bağlayan ölçümdür; perakende medyayı diğer kanallardan ayıran temel özelliktir.

## CMN (Commerce Media Network)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/cmn-commerce-media-network/

An advertising network run by a company with first-party shopper or transaction data, such as a retailer or marketplace, that sells ad space to brands; the term extends the retail media idea beyond the largest retailers.

CMN widens the retail media network model beyond players like Amazon and Walmart to other retailers and marketplaces that hold direct shopper data. The term circulated among ad tech vendors from around 2023 and became common in marketer trade press in 2025-2026. Marketers now evaluate a wider set of CMN partners as first-party-data ad inventory, and financial platforms run a related variant, FMN.

CMN, perakendeci veya pazaryeri gibi birinci taraf alışverişçi verisine sahip bir şirketin markalara reklam alanı sattığı ticaret medyası ağıdır; retail media fikrini en büyük perakendecilerin ötesine taşır.

## Cognitive Inequality

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/cognitive-inequality/

An unequal ability to control, understand, or benefit from AI systems, which leaves some people directing AI and others dependent on it.

Cognitive inequality, sometimes discussed as part of a broader 'cognitive divide' or 'AI divide', describes disparities that go beyond simple access to technology (the older digital divide) to differences in who can shape, question, and control the AI systems that increasingly mediate perception and decision-making, versus who is simply subject to them. Academic literature frames this as a multidimensional issue combining technological, institutional, and psychological factors, including the risk that some users treat AI as a genuine cognitive extension while others become dependent on it as a crutch. For marketers and organizations, this affects how confidently different customer or employee segments engage with AI-powered products and raises questions about equitable design of AI tools.

Turkish: Bilişsel eşitsizlik. Bilişsel eşitsizlik, yapay zeka sistemlerini yönlendirebilenlerle bu sistemlere bağımlı hale gelenler arasındaki, erişimin ötesine geçen kontrol ve anlama farkını ifade eder.

## Cognitive Offloading

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/cognitive-offloading/

A strategy of using a physical action or external tool, instead of pure mental effort, to reduce a task's mental demand.

Cognitive offloading describes behaviors such as setting a phone alarm instead of remembering an appointment, writing a note instead of memorizing a fact, or turning your head to view a rotated image more easily. The term is used in cognitive science literature, including research published in Trends in Cognitive Sciences, to describe how people manage limited mental capacity by shifting part of a task onto the environment or a device. Products and interfaces such as reminders, autofill, recommendation engines, and AI assistants succeed partly by giving users a place to offload memory and decision effort, and that shapes how much friction people will tolerate in an app or purchase flow.

Turkish: Bilişsel yük boşaltma. Cognitive offloading, bir görevin zihinsel yükünü azaltmak için fiziksel bir hareket veya dışsal bir araç (not, alarm, uygulama) kullanma stratejisidir.

## Commerce Media

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/commerce-media/

Commerce media is the monetisation of advertising across commerce ecosystems by using transaction, behavioural, and intent data from platforms where consumers shop or transact to influence purchase decisions.

Alışverişçilerin satın alma yaptığı platformlarda işlem, davranış ve niyet verisini kullanarak satın alma kararını etkilemeyi amaçlayan reklamcılığın genel adıdır; retail media bunun bir parçasıdır.

## Commerce Signal

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/commerce-signal/

Any shopper behaviour indicating intent.

Alışverişçinin satın alma niyetini gösteren her türlü davranıştır; arama, sepete ekleme ya da ürün karşılaştırma gibi.

## Connected TV (CTV) for Retail Media

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/connected-tv-ctv-for-retail-media/

Offsite television streaming ad units targeted and measured using deterministic 1st-party retailer shopping data and closed-loop attribution.

Perakendecinin birinci taraf alışveriş verisiyle hedeflenen ve kapalı döngü atribüsyonla ölçülen, internet üzerinden yayınlanan TV reklamlarıdır.

## Consumer Ethnography

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/consumer-ethnography/

A research method that studies consumers by directly observing their real behavior in natural settings rather than relying only on surveys or self-reported answers.

Ethnography originates in anthropology, where researchers embed themselves in a community to observe behavior firsthand rather than asking people to describe it after the fact. Applied to marketing, consumer ethnography means watching how people actually shop, use products, or make decisions in their homes, stores, or daily routines, which often reveals gaps between what consumers say they do and what they actually do. It matters for marketers because it surfaces unspoken needs, workarounds, and context that standard surveys and focus groups tend to miss; that gap informs product design and messaging that better fits real behavior.

Turkish: Tüketici Etnografyası. Tüketicilerin gerçek davranışlarını, anket veya grup görüşmesi yerine doğal ortamlarında doğrudan gözlemleyerek incelemeyi amaçlayan bir araştırma yöntemidir.

## Content Innovation

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/content-innovation/

The continuous development of new content formats, distribution methods, or storytelling approaches to keep a brand's communication relevant as media habits evolve.

Content innovation describes an organizational commitment to experimenting with how content is made and distributed, new formats like short-form video or interactive media, new production workflows, or new distribution partnerships, rather than repeating the same content playbook as audience attention shifts. It sits at the intersection of creative strategy and operational process, since sustaining innovation requires both creative risk-taking and the internal systems to test and scale new formats quickly. Content that worked well on yesterday's platforms and formats tends to underperform as audience attention and platform algorithms change, and that is why marketers keep pushing on this discipline.

Marka iletişiminin medya alışkanlıkları değiştikçe güncel kalabilmesi için içerik format, üretim ve dağıtım yöntemlerinde sürekli yenilik yapılmasını ifade eder.

## Conversational AI Commerce

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/conversational-ai-commerce/

Commerce conducted through conversational AI tools like chatbots and voice assistants instead of traditional click-based shopping.

Conversational AI Commerce uses chatbots, voice assistants, and AI-powered messaging to enable real-time, personalized shopping experiences. This model shifts from traditional e-commerce workflows to natural dialogue-based transactions. Marketers benefit from higher conversion rates, reduced cart abandonment, and richer behavioral data through ongoing conversations that build lasting customer relationships.

Chatbot ve sesli asistan gibi konuşma tabanlı yapay zeka araçlarıyla gerçekleştirilen ticaret modelidir.

## Conversion Rate (CVR)

URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/cost-per-mille-cpm/

Bin reklam gösterimi için ödenen tutardır.

Cost paid per view in video ads.

## CR (Conversion Rate)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/cr-conversion-rate/

Rate of conversion from ads or campaigns.

Dönüşüm oranı.

## Creative Intelligence

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/creative-intelligence/

Using AI to score and predict creative asset performance before campaign launch rather than after.

Creative Intelligence applies machine learning models trained on historical campaign performance to rate creative assets across metrics like brand recall, attention duration, emotional intensity, and purchase intent. Unlike traditional copy testing, it operates at scale and within the planning workflow. It marks a move from post-mortem reporting to pre-flight prediction, in line with WARC's Future of Measurement 2026 report, which identifies it as a defining shift in measurement.

Yaratıcı içeriklerin kampanya yayına girmeden önceki performansını yapay zeka modelleriyle tahmin etme yöntemidir.

## Crowded Loneliness

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/crowded-loneliness/

The experience of feeling isolated or emotionally disconnected despite being constantly surrounded by people and digital connections.

The Turkish phrase kalabalık yalnızlık (crowded loneliness) was named Turkey's word of the year for 2024 by the Turkish Language Association (TDK) working with Ankara University's communication research center, describing the paradox of feeling alone while surrounded by crowds and constant online contact. The concept echoes the argument of sociologist David Riesman's 1950 book The Lonely Crowd, which examined how modern, other-directed societies can produce conformity and social disconnection even amid dense social contact. The idea names a widespread emotional tension, hyperconnected yet isolated, that brands in wellness, social media, and community-building categories can speak to authentically.

Turkish: Kalabalık Yalnızlık. Sürekli kalabalık ve dijital bağlantı içinde olmasına rağmen kişinin kendini yalnız ve duygusal olarak kopuk hissetmesi durumunu ifade eder.

## CTA (Call to Action)

Calls directing users to specific actions (e.g., "Buy Now", "Register").

Kullanıcıyı belirli bir eyleme yönlendiren ifadedir; "Şimdi Satın Al" ya da "Kaydol" gibi.

## CTR (Content Traffic Rate)

Measures the traffic driven by social media content to websites or landing pages.
