Score indicating website strength in search engines.

Web sitesinin gücünü gösteren skor.

## Dark Social

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/dark-social/

Content sharing that happens through private channels like messaging apps and email, which standard web analytics cannot attribute to its true source.

Journalist Alexis Madrigal coined the term in a 2012 article for The Atlantic, after noticing that a large share of the site's traffic was logged as "direct" in analytics tools even though those visitors had actually arrived via links shared in private messages, chat apps, or email rather than by typing the URL directly. Because these referrals carry no tracking parameters, the true source of the traffic is invisible, hence "dark." A significant share of real sharing activity, often the most trusted kind, happens in these dark channels. Standard attribution models can undercount how content actually spreads and who is really driving conversions.

Doğrudan mesajlaşma veya e-posta gibi özel kanallar üzerinden yapılan, standart analitik araçlarla kaynağı tespit edilemeyen paylaşım biçimi.

## Data Clean Room

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/data-clean-room/

Privacy-safe environment for combining advertiser and retailer datasets.

Reklamveren ve perakendecinin veri setlerini, ham veriyi birbirine açmadan gizlilik korunarak eşleştirdiği güvenli ortamdır.

## DATT (Data in Marketing Think Tank)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/datt-data-in-marketing-think-tank/

A think tank dedicated to using data and AI to improve customer experiences and marketing efficiency.

Turkish: Pazarlamada Veri Düşünce Grubu. Veri odaklı pazarlama stratejilerini geliştiren düşünce grubudur.

## Deterministic Matching

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/deterministic-matching/

Linking consumer records across channels using verified, unique identifiers such as their purchasing habits (e.g., hashed email address, phone number, loyalty ID, CRM record) rather than statistical probabilities.

Kayıtları istatistiksel tahmin yerine hash'lenmiş e-posta, telefon numarası, sadakat kimliği ya da CRM kaydı gibi doğrulanmış tekil tanımlayıcılarla kanallar arasında eşleştirmektir.

## Digital Detox Tourism

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/digital-detox-tourism/

Travel experiences designed around unplugging from phones and the internet, offered by hotels and resorts as a wellness feature.

Digital detox tourism refers to trips or retreats marketed around disconnecting from devices, whether through device lockers, no-WiFi zones, or structured offline itineraries, positioned as a response to the stress associated with constant connectivity and scroll fatigue. It sits within the broader wellness travel market and appeals to consumers who feel that always-on digital life has become a source of burnout rather than convenience. For marketers, the trend is relevant to hospitality, wellness, and travel brands looking to differentiate through an explicitly analog or slow-paced experience.

Digital detox tourism, telefon ve internetten uzaklaşmayı merkeze alan, oteller ve tesisler tarafından bir sağlık ve iyi oluş deneyimi olarak sunulan seyahat biçimidir.

## Digital Maturity

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/digital-maturity/

The degree to which an organization can effectively use digital technologies and processes to create value and respond to change.

Digital maturity measures how well a company has adopted the tools, skills, and culture needed to run digital-first processes, respond to market shifts, and pursue digital transformation, rather than treating digital as a bolt-on to existing operations. It is not a single achievement but an ongoing capability that consulting firms and technology vendors assess using various maturity models and frameworks. For marketing leadership, digital maturity level directly affects how fast a marketing team can adopt new channels, personalization, and data practices, and low maturity is a common reason ambitious campaigns underdeliver.

Bir kuruluşun dijital teknoloji ve süreçleri kullanarak değer yaratma ve değişime uyum sağlama kapasitesi.

## Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH / In-Store Screens)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/digital-out-of-home-dooh-in-store-screens/

Digitized video screens, interactive endcaps, and display panels located within physical retail aisles and checkouts.

Mağaza koridorları ve kasalardaki dijital video ekranları, etkileşimli kiosklar ve dijital panolardan oluşan reklam alanıdır.

## Digital Shelf Optimisation

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/digital-shelf-optimisation/

Improving discoverability + conversion.

Ürünlerin dijital raflarda, yani e-ticaret sitelerinde, daha kolay bulunmasını ve daha çok satmasını sağlamaya yönelik çalışmalardır.

## Digital Twin Technology

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/digital-twin-technology/

A virtual, continuously updated model of a real physical object, process, or system, used to simulate and predict its behavior.

A digital twin is a software replica of something physical, a factory line, a building, a supply chain, or even a city, built from real-time sensor data so that changes in the physical original are reflected in the model, allowing teams to test scenarios or predict maintenance needs without disrupting the real system. It originated in manufacturing and aerospace engineering and has since spread to logistics, healthcare, and urban planning. For marketers in industrial, B2B, and technology sectors, the term gives a concrete way to describe efficiency and predictive-maintenance benefits to technical buyers.

Turkish: Dijital ikiz. Digital twin technology, bir nesnenin, sürecin veya sistemin gerçek zamanlı verilerle güncellenen sanal bir kopyasını oluşturarak davranışını simüle eden teknolojidir.

## Distorted Reality

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/distorted-reality/

The gap between curated, filtered, or manipulated media content and actual reality, especially as shaped by social media and retouched marketing imagery.

Distorted reality describes how heavily edited photos, selectively curated feeds, and idealized marketing visuals can create a false or exaggerated impression of a product, lifestyle, or person. The concept is not tied to one coiner; it has been discussed for years in media literacy and marketing-ethics writing as digital editing tools and social platforms made manipulation cheap and widespread. Consumers increasingly notice and react against unrealistic imagery, and brands that lean on authenticity and unretouched content often build more durable trust than those relying on idealized visuals.

Sosyal medya ve pazarlama görsellerindeki filtrelenmiş, rötuşlanmış içeriklerin gerçeklikle arasındaki farkı ifade eden kavram.

## DMA (Digital Markets Act)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/dma-digital-markets-act/

An EU regulation that limits the economic power of designated gatekeeper platforms, such as restricting self-preferencing and cross-service data combination.

DMA entered force in 2022-2023, and gatekeeper compliance changes affecting marketer workflows landed through 2024-2025. Gatekeeper obligations affect how marketers can target and measure on platforms like Google and Meta in the EU. Repeat violations by gatekeepers can trigger fines up to 20 percent of global turnover, which reshapes the targeting options available to marketers.

DMA, örneğin kendi hizmetini kayırma veya hizmetler arası veri birleştirmeyi kısıtlayarak belirlenmiş bekçi platformların ekonomik gücünü sınırlayan bir AB düzenlemesidir.

## Doomscrolling

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/doomscrolling/

The habit of continuously scrolling through distressing or negative news and social media content, even when it causes anxiety.

Doomscrolling describes compulsively consuming a stream of alarming or negative information, usually through a smartphone, well past the point where it stops being informative and starts causing emotional harm. Usage of the term surged during the COVID-19 pandemic and periods of major news events, when 24-hour news cycles and algorithm-driven feeds made it easy to stay locked into distressing content. For marketers and platforms, it raises questions about content design, notification strategy, and audience wellbeing, and it has pushed some brands and apps toward messaging around digital breaks and healthier feed habits.

Kaygı veya sıkıntı yaratsa bile olumsuz haber ve sosyal medya içeriklerinde durmaksızın gezinme alışkanlığı.

## DSA (Digital Services Act)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/dsa-digital-services-act/

An EU regulation setting mandatory rules for online platforms on content moderation, ad transparency, and targeted-advertising disclosure.

DSA entered force in 2022-2023, but its ad-specific codes of conduct and marketer compliance activity concentrated through 2024-2025. Article 46 requires ad-supply-chain traceability, so marketers targeting EU users must follow these rules or face fines. A German advertising federation response to the EDPB's October 2025 public consultation discussed the DSA's advertising transparency requirements in detail.

DSA, çevrimiçi platformlar için içerik denetimi, reklam şeffaflığı ve hedefli reklam bildirimi konusunda zorunlu kurallar getiren bir AB düzenlemesidir.

## DSP (Demand-Side Platform)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/dsp-demand-side-platform/

Platform for buying digital ad inventory.

Reklamverenlerin dijital reklam alanını otomatik olarak satın aldığı platformdur.

## DTC (Direct-to-Consumer)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/dtc-direct-to-consumer/

Business model selling directly to consumers without intermediaries.

Markanın aracı kullanmadan doğrudan tüketiciye sattığı iş modelidir.

## Dynamic Creative Optimization (DCO)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/dynamic-creative-optimization-dco/

Ad technology that dynamically creates personalized ad variants at serving time by pulling in real-time retail signals such as stock level, localized pricing, and shopper affinities.

Stok durumu, yerel fiyat ve alışverişçi ilgisi gibi gerçek zamanlı sinyallere göre reklamın kişiselleştirilmiş versiyonlarını yayın anında otomatik üreten teknolojidir.

## E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/e-e-a-t-experience-expertise-authoritativeness-trustworthiness/

E-E-A-T is Google's content quality framework, used in its Search Quality Rater Guidelines, that now also functions as a de facto AI-citation quality signal.

Google added the second "E," for Experience, to the older E-A-T framework on December 15, 2022. A BrightEdge study cited in 2025 to 2026 coverage found that 58 percent of pages that lost traffic in 2024 lacked strong E-E-A-T elements, especially clear authorship. Google's September 11, 2025 Search Quality Rater Guidelines update refined YMYL evaluation and reinforced the framework's weight, and marketers now treat it as relevant to both classic SEO and AI Overview or LLM citation eligibility.

E-E-A-T, Google'ın içerik kalitesini değerlendirdiği ve artık yapay zeka yanıtlarında kaynak gösterilme olasılığını da etkileyen deneyim, uzmanlık, otorite ve güvenilirlik çerçevesidir.

## Early Bird

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/early-bird/

A discounted price or special offer given to customers who buy or register before a set deadline, used to drive early demand.

The early bird offer is a standard pricing tactic across events, travel, retail, and subscription businesses: buyers who commit early get a lower price or added benefit, while the brand gains early cash flow and demand signal well before the main sales period. It works on loss aversion and urgency, since customers who wait risk paying more or missing the deal entirely. For marketers, it is one of the most reliable levers for shaping the timing of demand, useful for events, product launches, and seasonal campaigns where predictable early sign-ups help with planning and cash flow.

Turkish: Erken kayıt indirimi (erkenci kuş indirimi). Belirli bir son tarihten önce satın alan veya kaydolan müşterilere sunulan indirimli fiyat veya özel teklif.

## Edutainment

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/edutainment/

Content that blends education and entertainment, designed to teach while also engaging and amusing the audience.

Edutainment is a portmanteau of "education" and "entertainment" used for games, films, shows, or digital experiences built to make learning engaging rather than dry. Walt Disney used the term as early as 1954 to describe the True-Life Adventure nature documentary series, and it has since expanded to cover eLearning platforms, branded content, and classroom technology. For marketers, especially in education, kids' products, and B2B thought leadership, content framed as edutainment tends to hold attention longer than a straightforward pitch while still delivering a brand or product message.

Eğitim ve eğlenceyi bir araya getirerek öğretirken aynı zamanda izleyiciyi eğlendirmeyi amaçlayan içerik türü.

## Effective Altruism

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/effective-altruism/

A philosophical and social movement that uses evidence and reasoning to determine the most effective ways to help others and allocate resources.

Effective altruism emerged in the early 2010s, associated with philosophers William MacAskill and Toby Ord at Oxford and influenced by Peter Singer's writing on global poverty and ethics. It asks donors, volunteers, and organizations to prioritize actions by measurable impact per dollar or hour rather than by emotional appeal alone. Brands running cause campaigns or CSR programs feel this shift already: audiences, especially younger and more skeptical consumers, increasingly expect proof of measurable impact rather than feel-good messaging.

Turkish: Etkili İyilik. Kaynakların ve yardımın en somut ve ölçülebilir faydayı sağlayacak şekilde, kanıta dayalı olarak yönlendirilmesini savunan felsefi ve toplumsal harekettir.

## Effective CPM (eCPM)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/effective-cpm-ecpm/

The actual monetization yield earned per 1,000 delivered impressions.

Bin gösterim başına elde edilen gerçek reklam geliridir; farklı fiyatlama modellerini karşılaştırmak için kullanılır.

## EGC (Employee-Generated Content)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/egc-employee-generated-content/

Organic content such as LinkedIn posts and short-form video that a company's own employees create, rather than its marketing team or paid influencers.

EGC was named and tracked as a distinct content category through 2025 trade press. As user-generated content and influencer costs rise, and audiences distrust polished brand content, marketers are formalizing employee advocacy and EGC programs. Forbes and other 2025 sources argue that EGC reads as more authentic than branded content.

EGC, pazarlama ekibi veya ücretli içerik üreticileri yerine bir şirketin kendi çalışanlarının oluşturduğu LinkedIn gönderileri ve kısa video gibi organik içeriktir.

## Endemic Advertiser

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/endemic-advertiser/

Brand that sells products within the retailer.

Ürünleri o perakendecide satılan reklamverendir.

## ENG% (Engagement Rate)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/eng-engagement-rate/

Measures post likes, comments, shares, and saves.

Gönderilerin beğeni, yorum, paylaşım oranı.

## Enterprise-Wide Modeling

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/enterprise-wide-modeling/

A management approach that spreads data modeling and simulation practices across every company function, beyond specialized technical or analytics teams.

Data modeling and simulation are traditionally confined to finance, engineering, or analytics departments. Enterprise-wide modeling extends that discipline organization-wide, encouraging marketing, HR, operations, and other functions to build and test models of their own decisions before committing to them. The underlying premise is that if modeling improves decision quality in one function, spreading that capability broadly should improve decision quality everywhere. The concept matters to marketers and executives as part of a broader shift toward data-driven, testable decision-making at every level of an organization, not confined to specialized analytics teams.

Veri modelleme ve simülasyon uygulamalarının yalnızca teknik ekiplerle sınırlı kalmayıp şirketin tüm fonksiyonlarına yayılmasını ifade eden bir yönetim yaklaşımıdır.

## EPM (Engagement Per Mille)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/epm-engagement-per-mille/

Interaction rate per 1,000 impressions.

1000 gösterim başına etkileşim.

## Extended Reality (XR)

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/extended-reality-xr/

An umbrella term covering virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and mixed reality (MR) technologies.

Extended reality is a category label used to group virtual reality (fully immersive digital environments), augmented reality (digital elements overlaid on the real world, typically via a phone or headset), and mixed reality (digital objects that interact with the real environment) under one term, since many devices and platforms increasingly blend these modes. For marketers, it is practical vocabulary for briefing agencies or vendors on immersive experiences, virtual product try-ons, AR filters, branded VR experiences, without having to specify the exact underlying technology up front.

Turkish: Genişletilmiş gerçeklik. Extended Reality (XR), sanal gerçeklik (VR), artırılmış gerçeklik (AR) ve karma gerçekliği (MR) kapsayan şemsiye bir terimdir.

## Fashiontainment

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/fashiontainment/

A brand strategy in which a fashion company acts like an entertainment business, building fandom through content, music, live experiences and licensing instead of relying on ad campaigns alone.

Fashiontainment treats a clothing brand as a source of stories and cultural moments, not only of products. The brand co-produces shows, partners with artists, runs live events and designs collections with the talent, so fans meet it inside the entertainment they already follow. The word blends fashion and entertainment. Gap Inc. CEO Richard Dickson uses the word to describe the company's strategy. In January 2026 Gap Inc. announced the hire of former Paramount executive Pam Kaufman (starting 2 February) in the newly created role of Chief Entertainment Officer; Retail Dive reported his view that 'fashion is entertainment', or 'fashiontainment'. Gap Inc. now uses Fashiontainment as the name of the platform Kaufman leads. Like edutainment and archivetainment, it is built by joining a field's name with 'entertainment'. For marketers, the test is whether a partnership builds a lasting fan relationship across content, stores and product, or is simply a celebrity campaign with a new name.

Fashiontainment, bir moda markasının yalnızca reklam kampanyalarına dayanmak yerine içerik, müzik, canlı deneyim ve lisanslama ile hayran kitlesi oluşturarak bir eğlence şirketi gibi çalıştığı marka stratejisidir.

## Feedforward

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/feedforward/

A future-focused alternative to feedback that offers constructive suggestions for what to do better next time instead of critiquing what already happened.

Feedforward replaces backward-looking evaluation (feedback) with forward-looking, solution-oriented guidance, for example saying "next time, keep your message shorter" instead of "your presentation was too long." It matters for marketing and leadership because it increases motivation and creativity in teams, shifts customer communication and campaign analysis from blame to improvement, and makes brands appear more innovative and trustworthy. The mindset connects directly to MMA Global's Project ROMI, which also focuses on forecasting the future business impact of marketing investment rather than only reporting past results.

Turkish: Feedforward (Türkçe blogda İngilizce terim aynen kullanılmış). Geçmişi eleştirmek yerine gelecekte daha iyi performans için yapıcı ve çözüm odaklı öneriler sunan bir yaklaşımdır.

## Fill Rate

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/fill-rate/

The percentage of available advertising inventory successfully sold and rendered.

Mevcut reklam envanterinin ne kadarının satılıp yayınlandığını gösteren yüzdedir.

## First-Party Data

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/first-party-data/

Data collected directly by the retailer.

Perakendecinin kendi müşterilerinden doğrudan topladığı veridir.

## FOMA (Fear Of Missing AI)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/foma-fear-of-missing-ai/

The anxiety that individuals or organizations feel about falling behind if they do not quickly adopt artificial intelligence tools.

FOMA is a recent coinage that plays on the older FOMO (fear of missing out), applied specifically to pressure around AI adoption. It surfaced in marketing and workplace commentary as generative AI tools spread rapidly after 2023, and has since been studied by academics examining workplace anxiety about AI skill gaps and job security, sometimes labeled AI FOMO in that research. FOMA matters to marketers in two ways: it explains why clients and leadership push for AI-labeled products even without a clear use case, and it is itself a psychological trigger that some AI vendors intentionally use in their own marketing.

Yapay zekayı hızla benimsemeyen kişi veya kurumların geride kalma korkusunu ifade eden bir terimdir.

## Frankenstack

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/frankenstack/

A marketing or advertising technology stack assembled from many separately bought tools that were bolted together over time and do not work as one system.

A Frankenstack is what a marketing team ends up with when each department buys its own tools for data, media buying, creative and reporting, and the pieces are later wired together with manual work, exports and custom connectors. The word blends Frankenstein and tech stack: a system built from mismatched parts that runs, but badly. It comes from the martech world. The earliest verifiable use found is a 31 March 2015 chiefmartec.com post by its editor Scott Brinker, who wrote that the phrase had entered the industry's lingo; six weeks later, in a CIO.com interview, he called it a 'humorous label' for stacks that grew out of marketing silos. No single coiner is known. In 2025 and 2026 the term returned in adtech coverage as teams started adding AI tools and agents on top of these stacks. Before a team adds another AI tool, it pays to check whether the tool connects the existing data and workflows or just adds one more part to the stack.

Frankenstack, zamanla ayrı ayrı alınıp birbirine eklenen ve tek bir sistem gibi çalışmayan araçlardan oluşan pazarlama ya da reklam teknolojisi altyapısıdır.

## FSS (First Second Strategy)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/fss-first-second-strategy/

A neuroscience-based study analyzing how consumers react to advertising within the first second of exposure.

Turkish: İlk Saniye Stratejisi. Reklamların ilk saniyelerde beyin üzerindeki etkisini inceleyen nöropazarlama araştırması.

## Funvertising

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/funvertising/

Advertising that emphasizes playfulness, humor, and entertainment value as its primary way of engaging an audience, rather than direct persuasion.

Funvertising is an informal blend of fun and advertising, closely related to the more established concept of advertainment (advertising plus entertainment). It is not a term with a single credited coiner or a formal academic definition; it is used across agencies and campaigns to describe work built around jokes, games, or playful brand characters rather than conventional product claims. The underlying idea matters to marketers because entertaining content earns attention and sharing in ways that straightforward sales messaging often does not, particularly on social platforms.

Turkish: Reğlence. "Reklam" ve "eğlence" kelimelerinin birleşiminden türeyen, doğrudan satış mesajı yerine mizah ve eğlence unsuruyla izleyiciyi etkilemeyi amaçlayan reklamcılık yaklaşımıdır.

## GA (Google Analytics)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ga-google-analytics/

Web analytics service by Google.

Google web analizi hizmeti.

## GA4 (Google Analytics 4)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ga4-google-analytics-4/

Google’s advanced analytics platform for tracking user interactions.

Google'ın web sitesi ve uygulamalardaki kullanıcı etkileşimlerini birlikte ölçen analitik platformudur.

## GAIO (Generative AI Optimization)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/gaio-generative-ai-optimization/

The practice of structuring and optimizing brand content so that generative AI tools and chatbots cite, reference, or recommend it in their answers.

GAIO extends the logic of search engine optimization to a world where consumers increasingly get answers from AI systems like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Bing Chat instead of a list of search results. Rather than optimizing for keyword rankings and backlinks, GAIO focuses on clarity, structure, and factual consistency so AI models are more likely to surface, paraphrase, or cite a brand's content as a trustworthy source. The discipline is still emerging and terminology is not fully settled, with related labels such as AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) used by different practitioners for similar practices. Being invisible to AI answer engines increasingly means being invisible to the customer at the point of decision, which is why GAIO matters to marketers.

Marka içeriğinin, üretken yapay zeka araçları tarafından yanıtlarda alıntılanacak veya önerilecek şekilde yapılandırılması ve optimize edilmesi pratiğidir.

## Gen Z Mindset

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/gen-z-mindset/

The distinct values, media habits, and expectations of Generation Z consumers that marketers must understand to engage them effectively.

Generation Z, generally defined as people born from the late 1990s through the early 2010s, grew up as digital natives with constant access to smartphones and social platforms, which shapes their expectations around authenticity, speed, and two-way brand interaction differently from prior generations. Marketing to this cohort effectively requires more than adjusting media channels; it requires understanding their skepticism toward traditional advertising, preference for creator-driven and peer-validated content, and higher expectations around brand values and transparency. Messaging and formats calibrated for millennial or older audiences frequently fail to land with Gen Z without deliberate adaptation, which is why understanding this mindset matters to marketers.

Z kuşağı tüketicilerin pazarlamacıların etkili iletişim kurabilmesi için anlaması gereken kendine özgü değerlerini, medya alışkanlıklarını ve beklentilerini ifade eder.

## Gen Zalpha

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/gen-zalpha/

An informal micro-generation label for people born around the cusp of Generation Z and Generation Alpha, blending traits of both cohorts.

Gen Zalpha is used to describe individuals, roughly those born in the mid-to-late 2000s to early 2010s, who share Gen Z's formative experience of social media's rise and Gen Alpha's status as full digital natives raised with even more advanced technology from birth. It is a marketing and commentary term rather than a formally defined demographic cohort from a research body like Pew, and different sources place its edges differently. For marketers targeting tweens and teens, this group blends behaviors from two adjacent generational frameworks, and some brands have specifically recruited "Gen Zalpha" influencer groups to reach both audiences at once.

Z Kuşağı ile Alpha Kuşağı arasındaki dönemde doğan, her iki kuşağın özelliklerini taşıyan kişileri tanımlayan gayriresmi terim.

## GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/geo-generative-engine-optimization/

The practice of shaping content so AI answer engines such as ChatGPT and Perplexity cite or recommend it, instead of ranking it as a plain search link.

GEO covers techniques for getting a brand mentioned or cited within AI-generated answers rather than only appearing as a link in search results. Researchers at Princeton, Georgia Tech, and IIT Delhi coined the term in a November 2023 paper, and it turned into a standard marketing discipline through 2025 as AI Overviews and chat assistants took share from classic search clicks. AI-referred web sessions grew more than 500 percent year over year in 2025, and visitors who arrive through AI search convert at several times the rate of ordinary organic traffic. Brands that skip GEO risk losing visibility as more answers get generated rather than clicked. The same practice is also marketed as AISO (AI Search Optimization), AIVO (AI Visibility Optimization), SAIO (Search AI Optimization) and GSO (Generative Search Optimization); when the target is AI shopping agents rather than answer engines, it is called AAIO (Agentic AI Optimization) or ACO (Agentic Commerce Optimization).

GEO, markaların ChatGPT ve Perplexity gibi yapay zeka arama araçlarının ürettiği yanıtlarda anılmasını veya önerilmesini sağlayan içerik uygulamalarını kapsar.

## Gibberlink

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/gibberlink/

A machine-optimized communication protocol allowing AI systems to exchange data through audio signals incomprehensible to humans.

Gibberlink emerged around 2023 when researchers discovered that AI systems generate structured patterns in 'gibberish' audio that enable direct machine-to-machine communication. Unlike human-readable language, this protocol is optimized for speed, precision, and privacy. In marketing, it enables real-time personalization, unified customer experiences across AI systems, autonomous decision-making automation, and natural security through non-human-readable data exchanges.

Yapay zeka sistemlerinin insanların anlayamayacağı ses sinyalleriyle birbiriyle iletişim kurmasını sağlayan makine-optimize protokoldür.

## GMV Max (TikTok Shop)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/gmv-max-tiktok-shop/

TikTok Shop's automated advertising campaign type that controls bidding, targeting, and creative distribution across the whole platform in a single campaign.

GMV Max is TikTok Shop's automated campaign format that handles bidding, audience targeting, and creative distribution platform-wide, attributing paid, organic, and affiliate sales to one automated campaign. It became mandatory for TikTok Shop advertising in September 2025, which means brands and agencies running TikTok Shop ads no longer have a manual-campaign alternative to plan around. Early adopters report roughly 30 percent higher GMV compared with manual Video Shopping Ads. Gross Merchandise Value itself is an older e-commerce metric; what is new is the mandatory automated campaign product built around it.

GMV Max, TikTok Shop'ta teklif, hedefleme ve reklam dağıtımını tek bir otomatik kampanyada birleştiren zorunlu reklam formatıdır.

## GPC (Global Privacy Control)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/gpc-global-privacy-control/

A browser-level signal that automatically tells websites not to sell or share a visitor's personal information for targeted advertising.

GPC works as a universal opt-out mechanism built into the browser rather than a setting a user configures on each site. Twelve US states require GPC compliance by 1 January 2026, including California, Colorado, and Texas, and California's CPPA voted in August 2026 to formally name GPC inside CCPA regulations. Joint enforcement sweeps began in September 2025, when Connecticut, California, and Colorado Attorneys General sent enforcement letters to businesses not honoring the signal.

GPC, bir ziyaretçinin kişisel verisinin hedefli reklam için satılmamasını veya paylaşılmamasını web sitelerine otomatik olarak bildiren tarayıcı düzeyinde bir sinyaldir.

## Hallucinate (AI)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/hallucinate-ai/

When an AI system, especially a language model, confidently generates false or fabricated information that is not grounded in its training data or reality.

In its AI sense, to hallucinate means a system like a chatbot produces plausible-sounding but incorrect or invented content, such as fake citations, wrong facts, or nonexistent events, stated with the same confidence as accurate output. Cambridge Dictionary named "hallucinate" its Word of the Year for 2023 specifically because of this new AI-related meaning; the choice showed how central the issue had become as generative AI tools spread. For marketers using AI for copy, research, or customer-facing chat, unchecked hallucinations can put false claims or made-up statistics into published content. Outputs need fact-checking before use, or the result is legal and reputational risk.

Bir yapay zeka sisteminin, özellikle dil modellerinin, gerçek olmayan veya uydurma bilgiyi kendinden emin bir şekilde üretmesi.

## HITL (Human in the Loop)

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/hitl-human-in-the-loop/

Human in the Loop is an operating principle where a trained person reviews or approves higher-risk AI agent actions, such as sends, payments, deletions or published content, before they execute.

It is an established machine-learning term that became a mainstream marketing-ops governance pattern through 2025 to 2026 as agentic marketing scaled. As marketing teams deploy AI agents for content, campaigns and even spend decisions, HITL separates safe "read" actions an agent can do freely from "write" actions that need sign-off, and it also works as a trust signal to consumers wary of unlabeled AI content. In marketing it usually means a person reviews and edits AI-generated campaigns, copy or assets before they are published.

HITL, gönderim, ödeme, silme veya yayınlama gibi riskli AI ajan eylemlerinin gerçekleşmeden önce eğitimli bir kişi tarafından incelenip onaylanmasını öngören bir çalışma ilkesidir.

## House Ads

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/house-ads/

Internal promotions run by the retailer.

Perakendecinin kendi ürünlerini ya da hizmetlerini tanıtmak için kendi reklam alanlarında yayınladığı reklamlardır.

## Human Cloud / Fluid Workforce

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/human-cloud-fluid-workforce/

A model of work in which organizations source labor on demand from a global pool of independent, digitally connected workers rather than fixed employees.

The term human cloud was adopted by staffing industry analysts to describe digitally enabled work arrangements covering everything from sourcing a worker to paying them. It is a subset of the broader gig economy, encompassing online staffing, crowdsourcing, and online work services. Fluid workforce is used interchangeably to describe the same shift toward flexible, project-based talent. The model changes how marketing and brand leaders staff creative, analytics, and campaign work, often blending in-house teams with distributed freelance talent sourced through platforms.

Turkish: Esnek İşgücü. Kurumların sabit çalışanlar yerine dijital platformlar aracılığıyla talebe göre bağımsız işgücünden yararlanmasını tanımlayan bir çalışma modelidir.

## Human-Centric Marketing

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/human-centric-marketing/

A marketing approach that designs strategy, products, and messaging around genuine human needs and experience rather than around channels, technology, or internal processes first.

Human-centric marketing prioritizes the actual person, their needs, context, and emotional experience, as the starting point for decisions, rather than starting from a media channel, a technology capability, or an internal organizational structure and fitting the customer into it. It shares roots with human-centered design in product development, applying the same empathy-first discipline to marketing strategy and customer experience. The approach counteracts a common failure mode where marketing organizes itself around what is easy to measure or execute internally instead of what actually matters to the customer, which is its main value for marketers.

Strateji, ürün ve mesajlaşmayı kanal veya teknoloji yerine gerçek insan ihtiyaçları ve deneyimi merkeze alarak tasarlayan bir pazarlama yaklaşımıdır.

## Humanwashing

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/humanwashing/

The practice of making AI-assisted work look fully human-made, through handcrafted styling, named creators or behind-the-scenes stories, while hiding how much AI actually did.

Humanwashing is the mirror image of AI washing: instead of overstating AI to borrow a tech halo, a brand understates AI to protect an authenticity halo. Business ethicist Peter Seele introduced 'humanwashing of machines' in a March 2021 post, and in 2022 formalized it with Andreea Scorici and Mario Schultz in AI & Society as the deceptive use of a machine's human-like appearance to mislead people about what it can really do. Marketing writers then took the word over for brand and creative work: the WHAT'S ANU newsletter in December 2025, followed by agencies such as Flux+Form in 2026, where it now means passing off AI-generated content as human craft. The risk for marketers is trust: when undisclosed AI use surfaces, the brand is judged less on the AI itself than on the concealment.

Humanwashing, yapay zeka ile üretilen bir işi el emeği görünümü, isimlendirilmiş yaratıcılar ya da kamera arkası hikâyelerle tamamen insan yapımı gibi sunarak yapay zekanın katkısını gizlemektir.

## Hypertail

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/hypertail/

A new class of modular, configurable SaaS tools that integrate with AI agents to reduce IT dependency and enable rapid experimentation.

Hypertail is a new class of SaaS tools evolving toward flexibility and AI integration, reducing marketing teams' reliance on IT approval. The term was introduced by Riza Doruk Ercan at MMA NEXT! Conference. It addresses three needs: AI's growing power, business unit independence, and dynamic consumer expectations. Marketers gain faster campaign launches, smarter data-driven decisions via AI optimization, reduced acquisition costs, and faster adaptation to market changes.

Esnek, özelleştirilebilir ve yapay zeka ajanlarıyla bağlanabilen yeni nesil SaaS araçlarını tanımlayan terimdir.

## Identity Graph (ID Graph)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/identity-graph-id-graph/

A unified database combining fragmented consumer identifiers (loyalty card numbers, app IDs, hashed emails, cookie data, mobile device IDs) into single distinct shopper profiles.

Sadakat kartı numarası, uygulama kimliği, hash'lenmiş e-posta, çerez ve mobil cihaz kimliği gibi dağınık tanımlayıcıları tek bir alışverişçi profilinde birleştiren veritabanıdır.

## Immersive Storytelling

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/immersive-storytelling/

A narrative technique that places the audience inside the story using technologies like VR, AR, or 360-degree video rather than having them observe from outside.

Immersive storytelling uses technologies such as virtual reality, augmented reality, 360-degree video, or interactive installations to make an audience feel present within a narrative instead of simply watching it unfold. It grew out of documentary and gaming experiments in the 2010s and has since been adopted in advertising, museum exhibits, and branded experiences. For marketers, it can create stronger emotional engagement and memorability than a traditional ad, though it requires more production investment and works best when the format genuinely serves the story rather than being used as a novelty.

Sanal gerçeklik, artırılmış gerçeklik veya 360 derece video gibi teknolojiler kullanarak izleyiciyi hikayenin içine dahil eden anlatım tekniği.

## In-Store Media

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/in-store-media/

Retail media within physical stores.

Fiziksel mağazalar içindeki perakende medya alanlarıdır; ekranlar, raf etiketleri ve anonslar gibi.

## Inclusive Exclusivity

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/inclusive-exclusivity/

A brand strategy that creates a sense of exclusive, insider access while still keeping the experience open to a broad and diverse audience.

Inclusive exclusivity describes retail and brand experiences designed to feel special and limited to those "in the know," while avoiding the elitism or narrowness of traditional exclusivity, by welcoming a diverse range of people who discover or opt into the experience. It is a marketing and retail-trend term rather than an academic one, used to describe things like invite-only drops, member communities, or pop-up experiences that use scarcity and insider language without excluding based on demographics. For marketers, it lets brands generate desire and community loyalty through perceived exclusivity while still growing an inclusive customer base, without the reputational risk of appearing elitist.

Markaların, ayrıcalık ve içeriden olma hissi yaratırken aynı zamanda geniş ve çeşitli bir kitleye açık kalan deneyimler kurgulaması.

## Incremental Return on Ad Spend (iROAS)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/incremental-return-on-ad-spend-iroas/

A performance metric isolating purely incremental sales driven per dollar of ad spend, calculated by subtracting organic baseline sales via test-vs-control experiments.

Test-kontrol deneyleriyle organik satışlar çıkarıldıktan sonra, harcanan her birim reklam bütçesinin yarattığı ek satışı gösteren metriktir.

## Incrementality

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/incrementality/

The net-new sales and revenue generated strictly as a causal result of ad exposure that would not have occurred organically.

Reklam olmasaydı gerçekleşmeyecek olan, doğrudan reklamın yarattığı ek satış ve gelirdir.

## Infodemic

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/infodemic/

An excessive, fast-spreading flow of information, including misinformation and rumors, that makes a crisis harder to manage.

Infodemic blends information and epidemic and was coined by international relations professor David Rothkopf in a May 2003 Washington Post article about the SARS outbreak, arguing that a flood of exaggerated and false reports was making the crisis harder to contain. The term resurfaced and was popularized globally by the World Health Organization during the COVID-19 pandemic starting in 2020, describing how misinformation on social media and other channels spread alongside the virus itself and undermined public health responses. The concept is a reminder for marketers and communicators of the reputational and safety risk in adding to information overload or unverified claims during a crisis, and of the value of being a clear, credible source when audiences are overwhelmed.

Turkish: İnfodemi. Infodemic, bir kriz sırasında yanlış bilgi ve söylentilerin hızla yayılarak durumu daha da yönetilemez hale getirmesini ifade eder.

## Information Product

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/information-product/

A packaged piece of knowledge, such as an online course, ebook, or template, sold or reused repeatedly instead of being created fresh each time.

An information product is expertise or research turned into a reusable, sellable format, for example an online course, guide, template, or report, that can be delivered to many customers with little additional effort once created. In creator-economy and digital-marketing contexts, this model lets a person or company convert knowledge built for one purpose into a scalable offering, and it can also mean adapting an existing information product to a similar new request rather than starting from scratch. For marketers and consultants, it turns expertise into a repeatable revenue stream, and it lowers the barrier for less experienced people to present themselves credibly once they have a well-packaged product to point to.

Turkish: Bilgi ürünü. Bilgi veya uzmanlığı, tekrar tekrar satılabilen bir çevrimiçi kurs, e-kitap ya da şablon gibi paketlenmiş bir ürüne dönüştüren kavram.

## Intent (NLP)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/intent-nlp/

In natural language processing, a label that identifies the goal behind a user's message, such as a chatbot request to check an order or ask for a refund.

Intent is a core concept in natural language processing and conversational AI: it is the category assigned to a piece of user text or speech that captures what the person is trying to accomplish, separate from the specific words they used. A chatbot or voice assistant is typically trained on a labeled dataset of example phrases mapped to intents (for example 'order_status' or 'refund_request'), and it scores each new message against those known intents to decide how to respond or when to hand off to a human. Modern systems increasingly use large language models to infer intent directly rather than relying only on a fixed, pre-trained classifier. For marketers building or overseeing chatbots and customer service automation, this matters directly: how accurately a system recognizes intent determines whether automated conversations resolve customer needs or frustrate them.

Turkish: Niyet (NLP). Intent (NLP), bir kullanıcı mesajının arkasındaki amacı tanımlayan ve chatbot eğitim verilerinde kullanılan bir etikettir.

## Inventory Yield

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/inventory-yield/

Revenue efficiency of available ad inventory.

Mevcut reklam envanterinden elde edilen gelirin verimliliğidir.

## Jobpocalypse

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/jobpocalypse/

A media shorthand for the feared large-scale displacement of jobs by AI and automation.

Jobpocalypse blends job and apocalypse and is a recent coinage, attributed to the Financial Times in 2025, that first described anxiety about AI shrinking graduate and entry-level hiring and has since broadened to AI-driven job losses in general. The term captures public anxiety around generative AI's effect on hiring and the labor market, but economists and researchers are divided on its accuracy: some point to a real deterioration in entry-level hiring in fields like software, while others argue companies use AI as a cover story for cuts that are really driven by cost-cutting, sometimes called AI-washing. The term shapes how anxious both job seekers and employees are, which matters for messaging tone in recruitment and workplace communications, especially for marketers in employer branding, HR tech, or B2B software built for the workforce.

Jobpocalypse, yapay zeka ve otomasyonun neden olabileceği geniş çaplı iş kaybı korkusunu tanımlamak için kullanılan bir medya terimidir.

## Joever

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/joever/

An internet slang blend of Joe and over, originally mocking Joe Biden's political prospects, now used broadly to declare that anything is definitively finished.

The word originated on 4chan in October 2020, ahead of the US presidential election, as a caption on an image of a dejected Biden, itself inspired by a 2016 Huffington Post graphic declaring IT'S OVER for Donald Trump. The meme resurfaced heavily in July 2024 when Biden withdrew from the presidential race, spreading widely across social media. Its use has since broadened well beyond politics to casual, often humorous declarations that a situation, game, or storyline has reached an irreversible end. The term is a useful marker for marketers of how quickly political memes get absorbed into general internet vocabulary and social content.

Aslen Joe Biden'ın siyasi geleceğiyle alay etmek için türetilen, artık herhangi bir durumun kesin biçimde bittiğini ifade etmek için kullanılan internet argosu bir sözcüktür.

## JOMO

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/jomo/

"Joy of Missing Out," the contentment that comes from opting out of social obligations or constant online activity, in contrast to FOMO.

JOMO was coined by writer Anil Dash in a 2012 blog post as a deliberate counterpoint to FOMO (fear of missing out), a term Patrick McGinnis had introduced in 2004. Where FOMO describes anxiety about missing events or updates, JOMO describes the relief and satisfaction of stepping back from that pressure and choosing presence over constant connectivity. The concept tracks a real consumer shift toward digital wellbeing, slower travel, and mindful consumption, and it has shaped campaigns in wellness, hospitality, and lifestyle categories that sell disconnection as a benefit rather than a loss.

Sürekli bağlantıda olma baskısından uzaklaşmanın verdiği huzuru ifade eden, FOMO'nun (bir şeyi kaçırma korkusu) karşıtı olan terim.

## Kidult Consumer

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/kidult-consumer/

An adult consumer who buys toys, games, or collectibles for personal enjoyment rather than for a child, driven by nostalgia and hobbyist interest.

Kidult blends "kid" and "adult" and is used in the toy and collectibles industry for grown consumers, often collectors, who purchase items like construction sets, action figures, or trading cards for themselves. Industry reporting puts kidults at roughly a quarter of annual toy sales, with brands such as Lego expanding product lines specifically toward adult builders seeking complex, nostalgic sets. For marketers in toys, entertainment, and licensed merchandise, this audience buys based on nostalgia, craftsmanship, and franchise attachment rather than child-appropriate play value, and it needs different messaging and pricing than traditional toy marketing.

Bir çocuk için değil kendi keyfi için oyuncak, koleksiyon parçası veya oyun satın alan yetişkin tüketici.

## KOC (Key Opinion Consumer)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/koc-key-opinion-consumer/

Influential individuals whose opinions affect consumer decisions.

Tüketiciyi etkileyen mikro influencer.

## KOL (Key Opinion Leader)

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/kol-key-opinion-leader/

An influencer with recognized authority in a category, such as beauty, tech, or lifestyle, distinguished from a KOC, an everyday user whose reviews read as authentic.

KOL terminology originated in medical and scientific fields and is long established in Chinese social commerce platforms such as Xiaohongshu and Douyin. It is now crossing into Western marketing vocabulary as TikTok Shop and cross-border commerce push agencies and brands outside China to adopt the same tiered creator strategy, using KOLs for reach and KOCs for social proof. This is directly relevant to Turkiye and MEA marketers running cross-border TikTok Shop campaigns.

KOL, bir kategoride tanınmış otoriteye sahip bir influencer'dır ve incelemeleri daha samimi görünen sıradan bir kullanıcı olan KOC'tan ayrılır.

## KPI (Key Performance Indicator)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/kpi-key-performance-indicator/

A measurable value that shows how well a campaign, channel, or business is progressing toward a defined objective.

In retail media, KPIs fall into two groups. Media KPIs are attached to ad delivery, such as ROAS, CTR, sales uplift, and new-to-brand customers. Retail KPIs are the commerce and sales measures used alongside them, such as sales, share of shelf, and basket size. Agreeing on KPIs before a campaign starts makes results comparable across retail media networks.

Turkish: Temel performans göstergesi (KPI). Bir kampanyanın, kanalın ya da işin belirlenen hedefe ne kadar yaklaştığını gösteren ölçülebilir değerdir.

## Media KPIs

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/media-kpis/

Core campaign metric attached to advertising delivery.

Reklam yayınıyla ilgili temel kampanya metrikleridir; ROAS, CTR, satış artışı ve yeni müşteri oranı gibi.

## Retail KPIs

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/retail-kpis/

The commerce and sales measures used alongside traditional media KPIs

Medya KPI'larının yanında kullanılan ticari ve satış ölçütleridir.

## Last Click Attribution

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/last-click-attribution/

Credits the final interaction before purchase.

Satın almadan önceki son etkileşime tüm payı veren atribüsyon modelidir.

## Lazy Girl Job

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/lazy-girl-job/

A well-paid, low-stress job with strong work-life balance, popularized on TikTok as a rejection of hustle culture rather than literal laziness.

The term was coined in May 2023 by TikTok creator Gabrielle Judge, who described it as a deliberately provocative label for jobs, often nontechnical corporate roles like marketing, account management, or customer success, that pay reasonably well (commonly cited in the 60,000 to 80,000 US dollar range), allow remote or flexible work, and do not demand that work become a person's whole identity. Judge has said the name was intentionally a marketing gimmick meant to spark conversation about toxic workplace expectations and burnout, not a call to actually do less good work. For marketers, particularly employer brand and HR communications teams, it reflects a broader post-pandemic shift in what younger workers, especially Gen Z, say they want from a job: boundaries and balance over prestige or hustle.

Lazy Girl Job, TikTok'ta popülerleşen, iyi ücret ödeyen ve düşük stresli, iş-yaşam dengesine öncelik veren işleri tanımlayan, hırs kültürüne karşı çıkan bir terimdir.

## Lead Like a Scientist

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/lead-like-a-scientist/

A leadership approach that applies the scientific method, forming hypotheses, testing them, and using evidence, to organizational and marketing decisions.

Lead like a scientist reframes leadership as an iterative process of hypothesis and experiment rather than fixed conviction: a leader states an assumption clearly, designs a way to test it cheaply, and updates the decision based on what the data shows. It draws on the same logic behind A/B testing and lean experimentation in product and marketing teams, applied instead to broader strategic and people decisions. The approach builds a culture where campaigns, positioning, and strategy are treated as testable hypotheses rather than unquestioned assumptions from the most senior person in the room, which is why it matters to marketers.

Liderlik kararlarını sabit inançlar yerine hipotez kurma, test etme ve kanıta dayalı sonuç çıkarma mantığıyla ele alan bir yaklaşımdır.

## Learning Architect

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/learning-architect/

A professional who designs learning or experience environments rather than simply transmitting information.

The Learning Architect concept originated from education initiatives in Estonia and Singapore, redefining teachers as designers of learning experiences rather than content deliverers. The same logic applies to marketing, where leaders must become Marketing Architects designing end-to-end customer experiences. Success depends on intentional, empathetic design rather than information transmission. This shift reflects broader MMA Global initiatives in CAP and MMGF frameworks.

Turkish: Öğrenme Mimarı. Bilgi aktarmak yerine öğrenme ya da deneyim ortamları tasarlayan profesyoneldir.

## Lemonading

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/lemonading/

The active, creative practice of reframing a setback or hardship into an opportunity, rather than passively staying positive.

Lemonading, from the phrase 'when life gives you lemons, make lemonade,' describes a deliberate, playful reframing of a difficult situation into something workable or valuable, distinct from simple optimism because it requires creativity, adaptability, and active problem-solving rather than just a positive attitude. Researchers studying playfulness have found that people who approach setbacks this way cope noticeably better with adversity. In workplace and learning-and-development contexts, the term has been applied to turning unexpected obstacles, a failed project, a budget cut, a training gap, into a concrete, practical improvement rather than pretending the problem does not exist. For marketers and internal communicators, it offers a vocabulary for framing setbacks constructively in employee or customer communication without sounding falsely upbeat.

Lemonading, bir zorluk karşısında sadece iyimser kalmak yerine, durumu yaratıcı biçimde yeniden çerçeveleyip somut bir fırsata dönüştürme pratiğidir.

## LLM Share of Voice

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/llm-share-of-voice/

A brand's visibility and favorability within responses generated by large language models like ChatGPT and Claude.

LLM SOV measures how often and favorably a brand appears in AI-generated answers to consumer questions. As users increasingly consult LLMs instead of search engines, brand presence in these systems becomes strategically critical. This is not about clicks but about becoming part of the AI recommendation loop. First placement in an LLM response can establish default choice status across an entire category.

Bir markanın ChatGPT ve Claude gibi büyük dil modellerinin yanıtlarında ne sıklıkla ve ne kadar olumlu yer aldığını gösteren ölçüttür.

## LLMO (LLM Optimization)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/llmo-llm-optimization/

The discipline of building brand authority and structured content so large language models recognize a brand and surface it in conversational answers.

LLMO covers the work of establishing authority, structured content, and high information-gain material so large language models such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity treat a brand as a credible source. It became a widely used marketing term through 2025, as GEO and AEO agencies split off a narrower, model-focused sub-discipline. Search Engine Land and 5W Public Relations both published standalone LLMO glossary pages in 2025, treating it as a distinct field rather than a synonym for GEO. Several agencies now budget for LLMO separately from classic SEO or GEO work, since it determines whether a brand gets mentioned inside a model's answer at all.

LLMO, büyük dil modellerinin bir markayı güvenilir kaynak olarak tanıyıp yanıtlarında öne çıkarması için marka otoritesi ve yapılandırılmış içerik oluşturmayı kapsar.

## llms.txt

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/llms-txt/

llms.txt is a proposed plain-text file, similar in spirit to robots.txt or an XML sitemap, meant to help large language models find and prioritize a site's most important content.

Jeremy Howard of fast.ai and Answer.AI proposed the file in September 2024, and SEO trade press, including Search Engine Land and Ahrefs, has discussed it since as a low-effort AI-readiness step. Adoption stays low even so, at about 10 percent of a 300,000-domain sample cited by Ahrefs, and Google's Gary Illyes stated in July 2025 that Google does not support or plan to support it. Large empirical studies cited by these sources found no measurable AI-citation uplift from adding the file as of 2025 to 2026.

llms.txt, büyük dil modellerinin bir sitenin en önemli içeriğini bulup önceliklendirmesine yardımcı olması amaçlanan, robots.txt benzeri bir düz metin dosyası önerisidir.

Shopper data from loyalty programmes.

Sadakat programlarından elde edilen alışverişçi verisidir.

## Managed Service

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/managed-service/

Retail media campaigns executed by the network/provider.

Perakende medya kampanyalarının ağ ya da sağlayıcı tarafından yürütüldüğü hizmet modelidir.

## Many-Shot Jailbreaking

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/many-shot-jailbreaking/

An AI safety vulnerability in which attackers use long prompts filled with many example dialogues to trick a large language model into bypassing its safety guardrails.

Anthropic researchers disclosed many-shot jailbreaking in 2024, showing that expanded context windows, which let models process much longer prompts, can be exploited by inserting a large number of simulated question-and-answer exchanges that gradually lead the model toward producing harmful content. The technique works because it takes advantage of in-context learning, the same ability that makes long-context models more useful for legitimate tasks. Anthropic found that hardening models through fine-tuning only increased the number of shots needed, while modifying the prompt itself was more effective at reducing the attack's success rate. The finding matters to brands deploying AI chatbots or generative tools: longer context windows widen both capability and attack surface, making safety testing essential before public deployment.

Saldırganların, çok sayıda örnek diyalog içeren uzun bir istemle büyük dil modellerinin güvenlik korumalarını atlatmaya çalıştığı bir yapay zeka güvenlik açığıdır.

## Marketplace

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/marketplace/

Platform where multiple sellers transact.

Birden fazla satıcının ürün sattığı platformdur; Takealot ve Amazon gibi.

URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/mars-mobile-analytics-real-time-social/

A framework for marketing strategies that integrate mobile, analytics, real-time decision-making, and social media.

Turkish: Mobil, Analitik, Gerçek Zamanlı, Sosyal. Mobil ve sosyal medya pazarlaması için veri odaklı analiz yöntemleri sunar.

## MATT (Marketing Attribution Think Tank)

A think tank dedicated to improving marketing attribution and proving marketing’s impact on business growth.

Turkish: Pazarlama Atıf Düşünce Grubu. Pazarlama yatırım getirisi (ROI) ve pazarlama performansı ölçümleme konularında çalışan düşünce grubudur.

## MCB (Marketing Capabilities Benchmark)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/mcb-marketing-capabilities-benchmark/

An assessment system that measures individual team members’ marketing capabilities.

Turkish: Pazarlama Yetkinlik Kıyaslaması. Pazarlama ekiplerinin yetkinlik düzeylerini belirlemek için kullanılan analiz metodu.

## MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/mcp-model-context-protocol/

An open standard that lets AI models and agents connect to external tools, data sources, and platforms through one consistent interface.

Status: As of September 2026: introduced by Anthropic in November 2024; donated in December 2025 to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation, which now governs it as a vendor-neutral open standard.

MCP is an open standard Anthropic released in November 2024 so AI models and agents can plug into external tools and data sources without a custom integration for each one. Martech vendors covering analytics, CDPs, and ad platforms have moved quickly to add MCP support, since it is what lets a marketer query campaign data or trigger a workflow directly from a conversational AI tool. Trade coverage from Digiday and MarTech tracked marketing-specific adoption through 2025. It is becoming foundational plumbing for agentic marketing workflows across the stack.

MCP, yapay zeka modellerinin ve ajanların farklı araçlara ve veri kaynaklarına tek bir standart üzerinden bağlanmasını sağlar.

## Memevertising

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/memevertising/

A marketing technique that uses popular internet memes and humor to promote a brand and connect with online audiences.

Memevertising, also called memetic marketing, involves brands adapting or referencing viral memes in their content to feel current, relatable, and shareable rather than promotional. It grew alongside the rise of meme culture on social platforms in the 2010s and is used mainly in social media marketing, where humor and cultural relevance can spread a message further than a conventional ad. For marketers, it can generate organic reach and audience goodwill cheaply, but it carries real risk: memes date quickly, and a brand using one poorly or too late can come across as forced or out of touch.

Bir markanın hedef kitlesiyle bağ kurmak için popüler internet memlerini ve mizahı kullandığı pazarlama tekniği.

## Merchandising

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/merchandising/

How products are presented/sorted/promoted.

Ürünlerin nasıl sergilendiği, sıralandığı ve tanıtıldığıdır.

## Metamodernism

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/metamodernism/

A cultural sensibility positioned between modernism's sincerity and postmodernism's irony, now applied in marketing to describe brand tones that mix earnestness with self-aware humor.

Cultural theorists Timotheus Vermeulen and Robin van den Akker introduced metamodernism in their 2010 essay "Notes on Metamodernism," describing a cultural mood that oscillates between modernist hope and postmodern irony rather than settling into either. In marketing commentary, the term has been adapted to describe campaigns that combine optimism, honesty, and humor, appealing especially to Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences who are wary of both naive positivity and cynical detachment. For marketers, it offers language for a tone that has become common in youth-focused advertising: sincere but self-aware, hopeful but not saccharine.

Turkish: Metamodernizm. Modernizmin samimiyeti ile postmodernizmin ironisi arasında salınan, artık pazarlamada içtenlik ve mizahı birleştiren marka tonlarını tanımlamak için de kullanılan kültürel yaklaşım.

## Metaverse Economy

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/metaverse-economy/

Economic activity, buying, selling, and earning, that takes place inside persistent virtual worlds and platforms.

The metaverse economy refers to transactions involving virtual goods, digital real estate, avatars, and in-world services conducted inside virtual or augmented reality platforms, sometimes using conventional payments and sometimes crypto or platform-specific currencies. Interest in the concept peaked around 2021 to 2022 alongside major tech investment announcements, then cooled considerably as consumer adoption of fully immersive virtual worlds proved slower than projected, even as niche use cases (gaming economies, virtual events, digital fashion) persisted. For marketers, the term is a useful reminder to distinguish genuine, measurable virtual-world commerce from speculative hype when evaluating whether a metaverse investment fits a brand's actual audience.

Metaverse economy, sanal dünyalar içinde gerçekleşen alım satım ve gelir elde etme gibi ekonomik faaliyetleri ifade eder.

## Micro Drama / Vertical Drama

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/micro-drama-vertical-drama/

A serialized short-video format, filmed vertically for mobile viewing, that tells a story across brief cliffhanger episodes typically one to three minutes long.

Micro dramas combine the brevity of short-form social video with the episodic structure of traditional television drama, using a vertical 9:16 frame built for apps like TikTok and Reels as well as dedicated platforms such as ReelShort. Each episode ends on a cliffhanger designed to pull viewers into the next installment, trading the quick, standalone payoff of typical short-form content for sustained narrative tension across a season. Brands including Crocs, Procter & Gamble, and JCPenney have begun weaving product placement into micro dramas rather than running conventional ads, attracted by the format's high completion and rewatch rates. The format matters to marketers as a new branded entertainment channel that behaves more like serialized content marketing than traditional advertising.

Turkish: Dikey Dizi. Mobil izleme için dikey formatta çekilen, kısa ve heyecanlı bölümlerle ilerleyen dizi tarzı bir kısa video formatıdır.

## Micro-Moments

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/micro-moments/

Brief, intent-driven moments when a person reaches for a device to know, go, do, or buy something, coined by Google in 2015.

Google introduced micro-moments in 2015 to describe the many short instances throughout a day when someone picks up a smartphone with a specific, immediate intent, whether that is looking up a fact, finding a nearby store, learning how to do something, or deciding what to buy. Google grouped these into "I-want-to-know," "I-want-to-go," "I-want-to-do," and "I-want-to-buy" moments. The concept shifted marketing planning away from broad demographic targeting toward being present and useful at the exact instant a consumer has a need, and it shaped mobile search, local SEO, and real-time content strategies.

Google tarafından 2015 yılında tanımlanan, bir kişinin bir ihtiyacı karşılamak için cihazına yöneldiği kısa ve niyet dolu anlar.

## Mid-Funnel

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/mid-funnel/

Consideration-stage activity.

Satın alma yolculuğunun değerlendirme aşamasına yönelik faaliyetlerdir.

## MM25 (Peer Group for Marketing Executives)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/mm25-peer-group-for-marketing-executives/

A networking and knowledge-sharing group for senior marketing leaders.
