## MMGF (Movable Middles Growth Framework)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/mmgf-movable-middles-growth-framework/

A targeting framework that focuses marketing investments on consumer segments most likely to respond to advertising.

Turkish: Hareketli Ortalar Büyüme Çerçevesi. Pazarlama bütçesini en etkili segmentlere yönlendirmek için kullanılan model.

## MMM (Marketing Mix Modeling)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/mmm-marketing-mix-modeling/

A statistical measurement method that correlates aggregate spend by channel with aggregate business outcomes using regression, without cookies or user-level tracking.

MMM uses regression to compare aggregate spend across channels against aggregate business results, without relying on cookies, device IDs, or any user-level tracking. The technique itself is decades old, but it returned to mainstream marketing practice through 2025 and 2026 as the primary privacy-era measurement method, following continued signal loss and the cancellation of Google's Privacy Sandbox. An eMarketer and TransUnion survey found 46.9 percent of US marketers planned to invest more in MMM, with 27.6 percent naming it their single most reliable measurement method, ahead of multi-touch attribution. Free open-source tools such as Google's Meridian and Meta's Robyn have lowered the cost of entry.

MMM, çerez veya kullanıcı bazlı takip olmadan kanal harcamalarını toplam iş sonuçlarıyla regresyon yoluyla ilişkilendiren bir ölçüm yöntemidir.

## MOFU (Middle of Funnel)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/mofu-middle-of-funnel/

Content aimed at increasing interest of potential customers.

Huninin orta aşaması (ilgi).

## MOSTT (Marketing Organization Structure Think Tank)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/mostt-marketing-organization-structure-think-tank/

A think tank focused on analyzing and optimizing marketing organization structures.

Turkish: Pazarlama Organizasyon Yapısı Düşünce Grubu. Pazarlama organizasyon yapılarını analiz eden ve optimize eden düşünce grubudur.

## Move the Needle

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/move-the-needle/

A business idiom meaning to make a noticeable, measurable, and usually positive impact toward a goal.

The phrase comes from the image of a needle on a gauge or meter shifting position in response to a change, and it is used in business to describe an action significant enough to produce a measurable result, as in "the new campaign moved the needle on sales." It functions as shorthand for meaningful progress as opposed to busywork or activity that looks productive but changes nothing measurable. The phrase is often used to set expectations for a campaign or initiative: stakeholders asking whether something will "move the needle" are really asking whether it is worth the investment given the size of impact it can realistically produce.

Bir hedefe doğru fark edilir ve ölçülebilir bir ilerleme kaydetmek anlamına gelen iş dünyası deyimi.

## MQL (Marketing Qualified Lead)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/mql-marketing-qualified-lead/

A potential customer ready for sales engagement.

Pazarlama faaliyetleri sonucunda satış ekibine aktarılmaya hazır hale gelen potansiyel müşteridir.

## MRA (MarCaps Readiness Assessment)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/mra-marcaps-readiness-assessment/

A diagnostic tool that evaluates an organization’s marketing capabilities and their alignment with business strategy.

Turkish: MarCaps Hazırlık Değerlendirmesi. Pazarlama stratejilerinin ne kadar etkili olduğunu ölçen bir değerlendirme aracı.

## Multiexperience

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/multiexperience/

A design and technology approach that delivers a consistent brand experience across many devices, senses, and interaction modes, such as touch, voice, and gesture.

Gartner named multiexperience one of its Top 10 Strategic Technology Trends for 2020, defining it as the shift from single-device thinking to a multisensory, multidevice, multimodal way people interact with the digital world, spanning web, mobile, wearables, voice assistants, and immersive interfaces. Rather than building one experience per channel, organizations aim for a cohesive journey regardless of which touchpoint a customer uses. A fragmented experience across channels damages brand perception and conversion, so multiexperience thinking forces marketing and product teams to coordinate content and interaction design across every surface a customer might use.

Dokunma, ses ve hareket gibi birçok etkileşim biçimi ve cihaz üzerinden tutarlı bir marka deneyimi sunan tasarım ve teknoloji yaklaşımı.

## Native Placement

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/native-placement/

Ad matching surrounding experience - less disruptive than banners.

Çevresindeki içerikle uyumlu görünen, banner reklamlara göre daha az rahatsız eden reklam biçimidir.

## Navigating Media Shifts

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/navigating-media-shifts/

The ability of marketing organizations to adapt quickly and effectively as audiences move between media channels and consumption habits change.

Media shifts refer to the ongoing movement of audience attention, from linear TV to streaming, from search to social, from established platforms to emerging ones, that has accelerated with each new platform generation. Navigating these shifts well requires marketing organizations to rebalance budgets, measurement, and creative formats faster than media habits change underneath them, rather than reacting only after a channel's effectiveness has already declined. Organizations that treat media planning as a fixed annual exercise consistently underperform those that treat it as a continuous, adaptive process, a gap marketers cannot ignore.

Pazarlama organizasyonlarının, hedef kitlenin medya tüketim alışkanlıkları değiştikçe hızlı ve etkin biçimde adapte olabilme becerisini ifade eder.

## Neural Storytelling

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/neural-storytelling/

Using AI and neural networks to create emotionally resonant narratives tailored to trigger specific audience responses.

Neural Storytelling applies artificial neural networks and advanced language models to craft stories that evoke targeted emotional responses and influence behavior. Rather than automating narrative generation, it creates adaptive stories that respond to user behavior in real time. The concept was introduced by Vikram Chalana, CEO of Pictory, on Decoding AI for Marketers episode 16. It delivers stronger emotional connections, supports rapid-consumption habits through micro-story sequences, and enables dynamic adaptation based on audience interaction.

Belirli duygusal tepkiler uyandırmak için yapay zeka ve sinir ağları kullanılarak hikaye üretme sürecidir.

## Neuromarketing 2.0

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/neuromarketing-2-0/

A newer wave of neuromarketing that combines traditional biometric and neuroscience methods with AI-driven analysis of consumer behavior.

Neuromarketing studies how consumers' brains and bodies respond to marketing stimuli using tools like eye tracking, EEG, and facial coding; the '2.0' framing used by some industry commentary refers to layering AI and large-scale behavioral data analysis on top of these older methods to generate faster, more scalable insight into attention, emotion, and decision-making. The promise for marketers is more precise measurement of what actually drives attention and purchase intent than consumers can self-report in surveys, though it also raises questions about data privacy and the ethics of influencing subconscious decision-making.

Neuromarketing 2.0, geleneksel nörobilim yöntemlerini yapay zeka destekli veri analiziyle birleştiren yeni nesil nöropazarlama yaklaşımını ifade eder.

## New-to-Brand

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/new-to-brand/

Customers who have not purchased the brand before - key acquisition metric.

Markayı daha önce hiç satın almamış müşterilerdir; önemli bir kazanım metriğidir.

## Newsjacking

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/newsjacking/

The practice of injecting a brand's message or perspective into a breaking news story to gain attention and media coverage.

Newsjacking was coined by marketer David Meerman Scott, who popularized it in his 2011 book of the same name, describing how brands can attach their own content or commentary to a trending news event to ride its existing attention. Done well, it means offering a genuinely relevant insight or reaction quickly while a story is still current; done poorly, it can look opportunistic or tone-deaf, especially around sensitive events. For marketers, it is one of the fastest ways to gain visibility without paid media, but it requires speed, editorial judgment, and sensitivity to avoid backlash.

Bir markanın mesajını, gündemdeki bir haberin dikkatinden yararlanmak için o habere dahil etme pratiği.

## Nightshade

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/nightshade/

A free tool that lets artists subtly alter their digital images so that AI models trained on them produce corrupted or incorrect results, discouraging unauthorized use in AI training.

Nightshade was developed by University of Chicago professor Ben Zhao and his team of PhD students, building on their earlier tool Glaze, which disrupts an AI's ability to mimic a specific artist's style. Nightshade goes further by poisoning the training data itself, making pixel-level changes invisible to the human eye that cause image-generating models such as Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, or DALL-E to misclassify the image, for example rendering a dog as a cat once a model has trained on enough poisoned samples. The goal is to give artists more negotiating power against companies scraping their work without permission or compensation. Nightshade signals a growing wave of technical resistance to unauthorized AI training on copyrighted creative work, a trend marketers in content, brand, and creative licensing are tracking closely.

Sanatçıların dijital eserlerini, yapay zeka modelleri bu görsellerle eğitildiğinde hatalı sonuçlar üretecek şekilde ince biçimde değiştirmelerini sağlayan, izinsiz kullanımı caydırmayı amaçlayan bir araçtır.

## Non-Endemic Advertiser

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/non-endemic-advertiser/

Advertiser not selling directly in retailer ecosystem.

Ürünleri o perakendecide satılmayan reklamverendir; banka, sigorta ya da otomotiv markaları gibi.

## NSFW (Not Safe For Work)

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/nsfw-not-safe-for-work/

An internet label warning that content, usually sexual, violent, or explicit, is inappropriate to view in a workplace or public setting.

NSFW stands for Not Safe For Work and grew out of early 2000s internet forums, where users needed a quick way to flag material that could embarrass someone or get them in trouble if opened at the office. The exact phrase surfaced in an August 2000 headline on the news site Fark, and the four-letter abbreviation began circulating on Usenet around 2001 to 2002 before entering major dictionaries in the 2010s. Platforms, and the automated moderation systems built on the same idea, use the label to restrict ad placement, algorithmic reach, and monetization, so content flagged NSFW usually loses distribution and brand-safety approval.

NSFW, işyerinde veya herkese açık bir ortamda izlenmesi uygun olmayan (genellikle cinsel veya şiddet içeren) içerikleri işaretlemek için kullanılan bir internet kısaltmasıdır.

## Offsite Retail Media

Retail audience targeting beyond retailer-owned properties.

Perakendecinin kitle verisiyle, perakendecinin kendi kanallarının dışında yapılan hedeflemedir.

## Omnichannel Closed-Loop Attribution

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/omnichannel-closed-loop-attribution/

Attribution methodology linking digital ad exposures (onsite or offsite) to in-store physical till transactions via unified loyalty cards or digital payments.

Dijital reklam maruziyetini, site içi ya da dışı fark etmeksizin, sadakat kartı veya dijital ödeme üzerinden mağazadaki kasa işlemlerine bağlayan atribüsyon yöntemidir.

Dijital ve mağaza içi kanalları tek bir planda birleştiren perakende medyadır.

Process of managing a brand's online reputation.

## Owned & Operated Media

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/owned-operated-media/

Advertising inventory located within properties directly owned and controlled by retailers, i.e web, app, stores, CRM.

Perakendecinin doğrudan sahip olduğu ve yönettiği kanallardaki reklam envanteridir; web sitesi, uygulama, mağazalar ve CRM gibi.

## Digital

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/digital/

In retail media, the online and screen-based channels where ads run, such as retailer websites, apps, emails, and in-store digital screens, as opposed to printed or physical media.

Digital channels let retailers target shoppers with first-party data, change creative in real time, and measure results against actual sales, which is harder with print or static in-store media. Most retail media spend, including sponsored products, onsite display, and offsite extension, runs on digital channels.

Turkish: Dijital. Perakende medyasında reklamların yayınlandığı web sitesi, uygulama, e-posta ve mağaza içi dijital ekran gibi çevrimiçi ve ekran tabanlı kanallardır.

## P(doom)

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/p-doom/

Shorthand in AI safety discussions for a person's estimated probability that advanced AI causes human extinction or civilizational collapse.

P(doom), read as probability of doom, originated inside rationalist and AI-safety research communities as informal shorthand researchers used to compare personal estimates of catastrophic AI risk. The term reached wider public attention around 2023 as generative AI advanced quickly and prominent researchers, including some who helped build the technology, began publicly stating their own P(doom) figures, which range widely from near zero to over 50%. A widely cited 2023 survey of AI researchers found a mean estimate around 14% and a median around 5% for AI contributing to human extinction or similarly severe outcomes within 100 years. For marketers in the AI and technology space, the term functions mainly as cultural shorthand: using it correctly signals fluency with how the AI industry and its critics talk about existential risk, which shapes tone when writing about AI products.

P(doom), gelişmiş yapay zekanın insanlığın yok oluşuna veya büyük bir çöküşe yol açma olasılığını ifade etmek için AI güvenliği çevrelerinde kullanılan bir kısaltmadır.

## PDP (Product Detail Page)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/pdp-product-detail-page/

Product-specific page.

Tek bir ürüne ait detay sayfasıdır.

## Performance Media

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/performance-media/

Digital media planned and optimised towards measurable actions such as clicks, leads, conversions or sales.

Tıklama, potansiyel müşteri, dönüşüm ya da satış gibi ölçülebilir eylemler için planlanan ve optimize edilen dijital medyadır.

## Perk-cession

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/perk-cession/

The reduction or elimination of employee perks, like free meals or commuting benefits, as companies cut costs during an economic downturn.

Perk-cession combines perk with the recession-suggesting suffix -cession and was used by the Wall Street Journal to describe companies scaling back prized employee extras, free coffee, cab rides, catered meals, as they focus on cost efficiency. The trend became visible from around 2023 as many employers pulled back office perks that had grown during the tight labor market of the pandemic years, partly because remote and hybrid workers were not using in-office amenities like coffee bars and game rooms, and partly because of broader economic pressure to cut costs. The term names a real risk for marketers and HR communicators: employer brand and retention suffer if perk cuts are handled without clear, honest communication about why they are happening.

Perk-cession, şirketlerin ekonomik daralma dönemlerinde maliyetleri kısmak amacıyla çalışan ayrıcalıklarını (ücretsiz yemek, servis gibi) azaltması veya kaldırmasıdır.

## Perpetual Optimism

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/perpetual-optimism/

A leadership mindset that keeps belief and solution-focused energy alive through challenges, which strengthens team performance.

Perpetual Optimism is not positive thinking but a conscious commitment to remain hopeful, determined, and solution-focused despite uncertainty and change. Virat Khullar, Head of Marketing at Hyundai India, describes it as a force multiplier that amplifies skills, experience, and resilience. Optimistic leadership spreads through teams, encouraging agility, creative risk-taking, and customer-centric empathy. This cultural foundation, more than data or automation, drives lasting loyalty and bold strategy.

Zorluklara rağmen ümitli, kararlı ve çözüm odaklı kalmayı sürdüren bir liderlik tutumudur.

## Point-of-Sale (POS) Media

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/point-of-sale-pos-media/

Physical and digital advertising units situated at checkout points, including customer-facing payment terminals, digital screen carousels, and printed/digital receipt ads.

Kasa noktasındaki fiziksel ve dijital reklam alanlarıdır; ödeme terminalleri, dijital ekranlar ve basılı ya da dijital fiş reklamları gibi.

## Post-Click Attribution

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/post-click-attribution/

Measurement after a click.

## Post-View Attribution

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/post-view-attribution/

Measurement after exposure without click.

Reklam görüldükten sonra, tıklama olmadan gerçekleşen dönüşümlerin ölçülmesidir.

## Predictive Copy Performance

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/predictive-copy-performance/

Using AI to estimate how marketing copy will perform for specific audience segments before launch.

Predictive Copy Performance applies LLMs and AI models to score and optimize text-based messages before publishing. Yaniv Makover, CEO of Anyword, featured on Decoding AI for Marketers episode 21, emphasizes that LLMs not only generate copy but understand its likely performance. The system analyzes emotional tone and persuasion elements, simulates A/B test outcomes based on historical data, and recommends segment-specific language optimizations. This enables faster decision-making, better segment targeting, and higher ROI through performance-backed messaging.

Yapay zeka kullanarak pazarlama metninin belirli kitle segmentlerinde nasıl performans göstereceğini tahmin etme yöntemidir.

## Predictive Loyalty

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/predictive-loyalty/

Using AI to identify high-potential future loyal customers and proactively engage them before loyalty solidifies.

Predictive Loyalty shifts focus from rewarding past loyalty to forecasting and nurturing future loyalty. Marty Kihn, SVP of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, explained on Decoding AI for Marketers episode 13 that loyalty is about predicting the future, not rewarding the past. AI evaluates behavioral signals like purchase frequency, spend, engagement, and cart abandonment to assign loyalty scores. Marketers then deploy personalized campaigns before loyalty forms, growing the base of future loyalists and increasing customer lifetime value while optimizing loyalty budgets.

Gelecekte sadık müşteri olacak kişileri önceden belirleyip onlara özel adımlarla yaklaşma yöntemidir.

## Principal Media

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/principal-media/

A media-buying model where an agency purchases ad inventory as the buyer of record and resells it to clients, often at an undisclosed markup.

In principal media, an advertising agency buys media inventory in bulk directly from publishers or platforms, taking on the inventory as its own (acting as principal), and then resells that inventory to its brand clients, rather than simply placing the client's budget as an agent on the client's behalf. The margin between what the agency paid and what it charges the client is typically not disclosed. The model grew as agency holding companies faced pressure on traditional fees and sought new revenue, with major networks building their own principal-media units, for example WPP Media's GMI, Publicis's APEX, and Omnicom's OMnet. The model changes who actually controls pricing transparency in media buys, and it has drawn scrutiny from advertisers and industry bodies over conflicts of interest.

Principal media, bir reklam ajansının medya envanterini kendi adına satın alıp müşterilerine, genellikle açıklanmayan bir kar marjıyla, yeniden sattığı bir medya satın alma modelidir.

## Probabilistic Targeting / Matching

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/probabilistic-targeting-matching/

A model-based approach that estimates whether behaviors relate to the same or likely audiences without relying solely on personal identifiable information.

Kişisel tanımlayıcı yerine davranış verisi ve modeller kullanarak farklı sinyallerin aynı kişiye ya da kitleye ait olma olasılığını tahmin eden yaklaşımdır.

## Project ROMI (Return on Marketing Investment)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/project-romi-return-on-marketing-investment/

A study connecting marketing investments to financial growth by demonstrating measurable returns.

Turkish: Pazarlama Yatırım Getirisi. Pazarlamanın işletme büyümesine nasıl katkıda bulunduğunu analiz eden girişim.

## Quantum Computing

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/quantum-computing/

A computing approach that uses quantum mechanical states (qubits) instead of ordinary bits to perform certain calculations far faster than classical computers.

Quantum computers use qubits, which can represent combinations of 0 and 1 simultaneously through superposition, along with entanglement between qubits, to explore many possible solutions at once for specific problem types such as optimization, cryptography, and molecular simulation. It remains an early-stage, largely experimental technology outside a few specialized use cases, with most current systems requiring extreme cooling and still limited by error rates. For marketers, the practical relevance today is mostly indirect: faster future computation could eventually reshape data analysis, personalization modeling, and encryption standards, but near-term marketing claims that overstate current quantum capability should be treated with caution.

Turkish: Kuantum bilgisayar. Quantum computing, bilgiyi klasik bitler yerine kuantum durumları (kübitler) kullanarak işleyen bir hesaplama yaklaşımıdır.

## Queenager

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/queenager/

A blend of "queen" and "teenager" used for confident, stylish, middle-aged and older women who embrace their age rather than hide it.

Queenager was proposed by Alyson Walsh, journalist and founder of the style blog That's Not My Age, in a 2020 post arguing that older women deserve a more empowering label than "pensioner" or "OAP." The term reframes midlife and later life as a period of self-assurance and personal style rather than decline. The term names a large, high-spending demographic that fashion, beauty, and wellness brands have historically underserved or stereotyped; campaigns built around it position older women as aspirational rather than invisible.

"Queen" (kraliçe) ve "teenager" kelimelerinin birleşiminden oluşan, yaşını saklamak yerine özgüvenle sahiplenen orta yaş ve üzeri kadınları tanımlayan terim.

## Query Intent

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/query-intent/

Shopper intent inferred from search terms.

Arama terimlerinden anlaşılan alışverişçi niyetidir.

## Quick Quitting vs. Quiet Quitting

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/quick-quitting-vs-quiet-quitting/

Two distinct workplace trends: quick quitting means leaving a job within roughly a year, while quiet quitting means staying in a role but doing only the minimum required.

Quick quitting refers to employees, often younger workers, leaving a job in under a year when it does not meet their expectations on pay, growth, or work-life balance, a pattern LinkedIn's Workforce Insights data showed rising in the early 2020s. Quiet quitting is a different behavior: staying employed but consciously stopping any effort beyond the defined job description, a term that went viral after engineer Zaid Khan posted a TikTok about it in July 2022, describing it as "quitting the idea of going above and beyond." Together, the two represent opposite responses to the same underlying dissatisfaction, one by physically leaving, the other by mentally disengaging while remaining on payroll, and both matter for people-management and internal-communications work.

Turkish: Sessiz istifa (quiet quitting için). "Quick quitting" bir yıldan kısa sürede işten ayrılmayı, "quiet quitting" ise işte kalıp yalnızca gerekli asgari işi yapmayı ifade eder.

## Quiet Thriving

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/quiet-thriving/

A workplace approach in which employees make small, deliberate changes within their own control to find more meaning and satisfaction at work, rather than making a big change like quitting.

Quiet thriving emerged as a counterpoint to quiet quitting, describing employees who respond to burnout or disengagement not by withdrawing effort but by actively reshaping small parts of their role, a concept related to job crafting in organizational psychology, to increase a sense of purpose and control. It gained visibility through workplace commentary following the post-pandemic shift toward hybrid work, where employees increasingly expect their jobs to provide meaning rather than only a paycheck. The concept offers a low-cost, employee-driven path to reducing burnout and turnover without requiring large organizational restructuring, which is its appeal for marketers and employers.

Turkish: Sessiz gelişim. Çalışanların büyük kararlar almak yerine kendi kontrol alanlarında küçük ve etkili adımlarla işlerinde anlam ve tatmin bulmasını ifade eden bir yaklaşımdır.

## RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/rag-retrieval-augmented-generation/

An AI architecture in which a model retrieves relevant information from a knowledge base or the live web before generating its response.

RAG describes an AI setup where a model pulls in outside information before writing an answer, rather than relying only on what it learned during training. Facebook AI introduced the term in 2020-era NLP research, and it moved into everyday marketing vocabulary through 2025 as GEO, AEO, and LLMO practitioners began explaining it to clients as the mechanism behind AI search visibility. Google AI Overviews and Perplexity both use RAG-style retrieval before generating their summarized answers. Marketers now build content that is fresh, well-structured, and clearly sourced specifically so it can be retrieved by these systems.

RAG, bir yapay zeka modelinin yanıt üretmeden önce bilgi tabanından veya canlı web'den ilgili bilgiyi getirdiği bir mimaridir.

## RAIL (Responsible AI Innovation Lab)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/rail-responsible-ai-innovation-lab/

A research group developing ethical and practical AI applications for marketing.

Turkish: Sorumlu Yapay Zeka İnovasyon Laboratuvarı. Pazarlamada yapay zekanın etik ve güvenilir kullanımı üzerine çalışmalar yürütür.

## Reach

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/reach/

Number of unique shoppers exposed.

Reklamı gören tekil alışverişçi sayısıdır.

## Regenerative Agriculture Tech

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/regenerative-agriculture-tech/

Technology, such as soil sensors and data platforms, used to support farming practices that restore soil health and biodiversity rather than depleting them.

Regenerative agriculture tech supports farming methods like cover cropping, reduced tillage, and rotational grazing with digital tools such as soil health sensors, satellite monitoring, and carbon measurement platforms that help farmers track and verify environmental outcomes, sometimes to qualify for carbon credit programs. It sits at the intersection of agtech and sustainability, responding to concern over soil degradation from conventional intensive farming. For marketers in food, agriculture, and CPG supply chains, the term is relevant to sourcing claims and sustainability storytelling, provided the underlying practices are independently verifiable rather than only described in marketing copy.

Regenerative agriculture tech, toprağı tüketmek yerine iyileştiren tarım uygulamalarını desteklemek için kullanılan sensör ve veri teknolojileridir.

## Retail Media Platform (RMP)

A technological solution or software system that facilitates the management, execution, and analysis of advertising campaigns" within retail networks.

## Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/return-on-ad-spend-roas/

The gross revenue generated for every dollar spent on media (includes both incremental and non-incremental organic sales).

Medyaya harcanan her birim bütçe başına elde edilen brüt gelirdir; hem reklamın yarattığı ek satışları hem de organik satışları içerir.

## Revenue Share

Commercial model where provider takes % of media revenue.

Sağlayıcının medya gelirinden belirli bir yüzde aldığı ticari modeldir.

## RO (Reach & Overlap)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ro-reach-overlap/

Measures audience overlap across platforms.

Farklı platformlardaki kitlelerin ne kadar örtüştüğünü ölçen metriktir.

## ROBO (Research Online, Buy Offline)

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/robo-research-online-buy-offline/

A buying pattern where consumers research products online, then complete the purchase in a physical store.

ROBO, also called ROPO (research online, purchase offline) or webrooming, describes shoppers who compare prices, read reviews, and gather information online before buying in person, often to see or handle the product first or to avoid shipping delays. It is the mirror image of showrooming, where shoppers check a product in-store and then buy it online. For marketers, the pattern means online content, reviews, and search visibility directly influence in-store sales even when the final transaction leaves no online trail. That complicates attribution and makes omnichannel measurement harder to skip.

Tüketicilerin bir ürünü çevrimiçi araştırdıktan sonra fiziksel bir mağazadan satın aldığı alışveriş davranışı.

## ROEX (Return on Omnichannel Experience)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/roex-return-on-omnichannel-experience/

A study measuring the financial impact of omnichannel customer experiences.

Turkish: Çok Kanallı Deneyim Getirisi. Omnichannel stratejilerin pazarlama getirisi üzerindeki etkisini ölçer.

## RTM (Real-Time Marketing)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/rtm-real-time-marketing/

Instant marketing responding to current events.

Güncel olaylara ve anlık gelişmelere hızla yanıt veren pazarlamadır.

## Run Rate

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/run-rate/

Projected performance based on current pace.

Mevcut performans hızına göre dönem sonu için yapılan tahmindir.

## SAVE (Brand Safety Council Initiative)

Category: MMA Programs & Frameworks
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/save-brand-safety-council-initiative/

An initiative to develop brand-safe advertising practices and reduce digital advertising risks.

Turkish: Marka Güvenliği Konseyi Girişimi. Markaların güvenli reklam stratejileri oluşturmasını sağlayan girişim.

## Scroll Burnout

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/scroll-burnout/

Mental and emotional exhaustion from prolonged, often mindless scrolling through social media feeds.

Scroll burnout, closely related to the broader idea of social media fatigue, describes the depleted, foggy, or irritable feeling people report after extended scrolling sessions, often driven by infinite-scroll interface design that removes natural stopping points. Researchers link it to overstimulation of the brain's reward circuits by constant novel content, notifications, and social comparison, followed by diminishing emotional reward over time. Audiences experiencing scroll burnout become harder to capture with more of the same content, so brands increasingly need to earn attention with distinct, low-friction, or intentionally paced content rather than competing purely on feed volume.

Scroll burnout, sosyal medya akışlarında uzun süre, çoğunlukla amaçsızca kaydırma yapmaktan kaynaklanan zihinsel ve duygusal tükenmişliktir.

## Second-Party (2P) Data

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/second-party-2p-data/

First-party data shared directly and securely between two mutually agreeing parties (e.g., a CPG brand sharing CRM lists directly with a retailer inside a clean room) without going through an open broker.

İki tarafın karşılıklı anlaşmayla doğrudan ve güvenli biçimde paylaştığı birinci taraf veridir; örneğin bir markanın CRM listesini veri temiz odasında perakendeciyle paylaşması. Arada veri komisyoncusu yoktur.

## Seenager

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/seenager/

A blend of "senior" and "teenager" describing older adults, generally past traditional retirement age, who stay active, curious, and open to new trends.

Seenager describes people in their 60s, 70s, or beyond who reject the passive image often attached to old age and instead pursue travel, hobbies, fitness, and new experiences much as a teenager pursues novelty. The word began circulating online and in lifestyle press during the 2010s as a lighter, more positive alternative to labels like "senior citizen" or "elderly." Marketers read it as a signal: this age group wants to be treated as active consumers with disposable income and time, not as a passive demographic to be talked down to. Brands in travel, wellness, fashion, and technology increasingly build campaigns around this reframed image of later life.

Torun bakmak yerine yeni deneyimler arayan, aktif ve genç ruhlu yaşlı yetişkinleri tanımlamak için kullanılan "senior" ve "teenager" birleşiminden bir terim.

## Shopper Marketing

## Silver Spenders

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/silver-spenders/

Consumers aged 50 and above who form a fast-growing, financially powerful, and digitally active market segment.

Silver Spenders (also called the Silver Generation) are consumers 50 and older who hold a large share of household wealth and drive a growing share of global consumer spending, especially in fashion, luxury, retail, technology, and finance. They matter to marketers because they are discretionary and quality-focused spenders rather than purely need-based buyers, they show strong brand loyalty once earned, and they are increasingly active online, reviewing products and engaging with brands digitally. To reach them, brands need to move from age-based to lifestyle-based segmentation.

Turkish: Gümüş Nesil. 50 yaş ve üzeri, hızla büyüyen, finansal açıdan güçlü ve dijitalde aktif bir tüketici segmentidir.

## Smart Carts / Smart Trolleys

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/smart-carts-smart-trolleys/

In-store shopping carts outfitted with barcode scanners, weight sensors, and digital interactive screens that deliver contextual ads and wayfinding based on physical aisle location.

Barkod okuyucu, ağırlık sensörü ve dijital ekranla donatılmış, alışverişçinin mağazadaki konumuna göre reklam ve yönlendirme gösteren alışveriş arabalarıdır.

## Smart City Infrastructure

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/smart-city-infrastructure/

Connected sensors, data systems, and networks used to manage city services like traffic, utilities, and public safety more efficiently.

Smart city infrastructure refers to the networked hardware and software, sensors on traffic lights, smart meters for utilities, connected public transit systems, that cities deploy to collect real-time data and automate or optimize municipal services. It is often paired with data dashboards used by city officials to respond faster to congestion, energy demand, or safety incidents. For marketers in B2G, telecom, and urban technology, the term works as a category label for pitching connected-infrastructure products to municipal buyers, though implementations vary widely in scale and maturity across different cities.

Turkish: Akıllı şehir altyapısı. Smart city infrastructure, trafik, enerji ve kamu güvenliği gibi belediye hizmetlerini daha verimli yönetmek için kullanılan bağlantılı sensör ve veri sistemleridir.

## SMARTIES Coach

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/smarties-coach/

An AI-powered mentor tool from MMA Global (Marketing + Media Alliance) that helps marketers choose categories and prepare stronger entries for the SMARTIES Awards.

The SMARTIES Awards are MMA Global's awards program recognizing innovation and effectiveness in mobile and digital marketing. SMARTIES Coach is a generative AI assistant, built as a custom GPT experience, that guides entrants through selecting the right award category, explains what judges look for, shares examples from past winners, and walks users through submission requirements and deadlines. The tool lowers the barrier to crafting a competitive submission for marketers preparing award entries, and reflects MMA's own use of AI to support its member community.

MMA Global'ın SMARTIES Ödülleri için hazırladığı, katılımcılara doğru kategoriyi seçme ve başvurularını güçlendirme konusunda rehberlik eden yapay zeka destekli bir asistan aracıdır.

## SMoX (Smart Marketing Cross-Effectiveness)

## SoLoMo

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/solomo/

A marketing acronym for Social, Local, and Mobile, describing strategies that combine these three elements to reach consumers.

SoLoMo was coined by venture capitalist John Doerr of Kleiner Perkins in 2010 to describe the convergence of social platforms, location-based data, and mobile devices as a single, powerful marketing trend. The idea was that smartphones, always carried and always connected, let brands combine social proof, geographic relevance, and mobile delivery in one targeted message, for example a location-based offer shared through a social app. Historically, it named an early wave of mobile-first, geo-targeted advertising that anticipated much of today's location-based and app-driven marketing, even though the term itself has faded from everyday use.

Sosyal, yerel ve mobil unsurları birleştirerek tüketiciye ulaşan pazarlama stratejilerini tanımlayan kısaltma.

## SoM (Share of Model)

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/som-share-of-model/

Share of Model is an AI visibility metric that measures how often a brand is mentioned or cited by one or more LLMs as a share of total category brand mentions.

The metric is credited to Jack Smyth and Tom Roach and is positioned as the AI-era successor to Share of Voice. It is calculated as brand mentions divided by total category mentions, multiplied by 100, using a fixed set of prompts run across ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Several vendors, including Profound, Conductor and Semrush, now automate this calculation, giving marketing teams a direct KPI for AI answer presence.

Share of Model, bir markanın kategori içindeki toplam yapay zeka yanıt anımlarına oranla ChatGPT, Gemini ve Perplexity gibi büyük dil modellerinde ne sıklıkla anıldığını ölçer.

## Spitball

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/spitball/

An informal, unpolished idea thrown out during brainstorming, offered for discussion rather than as a finished proposal.

To "spitball" is to suggest a rough idea without much preparation, typically in a casual or collaborative setting where the goal is to generate many possibilities rather than to present a fully developed plan. The term borrows from the literal meaning of a spitball as something quickly formed and thrown, used figuratively in business and creative jargon for informal idea generation. In marketing and creative teams, it signals psychological safety in brainstorming: team members are explicitly invited to share half-formed concepts without the pressure of immediate polish, and ideas that would otherwise go unsaid can surface.

Beyin fırtınası sırasında, henüz olgunlaşmamış ve tartışmaya açık olarak ortaya atılan gayriresmi bir fikir.

## Spokeshologram

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/spokeshologram/

A brand character introduced by Best Buy in 2024, a holographic spokesperson named Gram used across its advertising in the AI era.

Best Buy unveiled the spokeshologram as part of a July 2024 brand refresh that included a new tagline ("imagine that"), an updated color palette, and a partnership with Google Cloud on generative AI features. The hologram character Gram appeared in back-to-school commercials across TV, online, and social platforms, positioning Best Buy as a destination for discovering new technology rather than just buying it. The term is notable to marketers as an example of a retailer using an invented, AI-themed mascot format to signal technological relevance without claiming the brand itself runs on AI.

Best Buy'ın 2024 marka yenileme çalışmasında tanıttığı, Gram adlı, yapay zeka çağına gönderme yapan hologram sözcü karakteridir.

## Sponsored Search

Markaların e-ticaret sitesinde ilgili aramalarda öne çıkmak için anahtar kelimeye teklif verdiği, açık artırmayla satılan reklamlardır.

## SSP (Supply-Side Platform)

Platform for publishers to manage and sell ad inventory.

Yayıncıların reklam envanterini yönetip otomatik olarak sattığı platformdur.

## Storyselling

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/storyselling/

A marketing approach that uses narrative techniques, rather than direct pitches, to sell products or services by building emotional connection.

Storyselling combines storytelling craft with a sales objective: instead of listing features, a brand builds a narrative with characters, tension, and resolution that leads the audience toward wanting the product. It draws on older ideas from advertising and copywriting about emotional persuasion, packaged under a term used mainly in marketing and sales-training content since the 2010s. Attention is scarce and consumers are skeptical of overt advertising, so a well-told story can carry a sales message further than a direct claim, particularly in video, social content, and brand campaigns.

Ürün veya hizmeti doğrudan anlatmak yerine hikaye anlatım teknikleriyle duygusal bağ kurarak satmayı amaçlayan pazarlama yaklaşımı.

## Strategic Storytelling

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/strategic-storytelling/

The deliberate use of narrative structure, combined with data and technology, to communicate a brand's purpose or strategy in a way that is memorable and persuasive.

Strategic storytelling treats narrative as a management discipline rather than only a creative one: it uses the classic elements of story, character, tension, resolution, to make complex strategy, data, or change initiatives easier for employees, customers, or investors to understand and act on. What distinguishes it from traditional brand storytelling is its integration with digital tools and data, using analytics to shape which stories are told and through which channels they will land most effectively. Audiences retain and act on stories far more reliably than they do on statistics or slide decks alone, and that is the discipline's core value to marketers.

Marka stratejisini veya amacını, teknoloji ve veriyle birleştirilen anlatı teknikleriyle akılda kalıcı ve ikna edici biçimde iletme yaklaşımıdır.

## Structural Chaos

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/structural-chaos/

The state in which an organization's complexity grows faster than its coordination, so activity rises while impact falls.

Structural chaos does not look like chaos: political shifts, economic pressure, and fragmented markets can look like growth until the system breaks. Its signature is more activity with less impact, because motion is not progress. The response the source proposes is resilience as strategy: anticipate, adapt, recover, align, and create value.

Bir organizasyonda karmaşıklığın koordinasyondan daha hızlı büyümesi; faaliyet artarken etkinin azalması durumu.

## Supermarketer

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/supermarketer/

A multi-skilled marketer who uses AI to unify strategy, content, media planning, and analytics into one workflow.

The Supermarketer is a marketing role empowered by AI to orchestrate strategy, content creation, media planning, and analytics under a single workflow, increasing campaign speed and enabling more personalized, consistent customer experiences across channels. It matters for marketers because it breaks down organizational silos between creative and analytical functions, but it also carries risks such as low-quality AI-generated content, data ethics issues, and loss of human touch if not managed with clear quality standards.

Turkish: Supermarketer (Türkçe blogda İngilizce terim aynen kullanılmış). Yapay zeka desteğiyle strateji, içerik, medya planlama ve analitiği tek bir iş akışında birleştiren çok yetkinlikli pazarlamacı rolüdür.

## Sustainable Fashion Tech

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/sustainable-fashion-tech/

Technologies, such as recycled materials, digital sampling, and supply chain tracking, aimed at reducing fashion's environmental impact.

Sustainable fashion tech covers a range of applications including biofabricated or recycled textiles, 3D digital garment sampling that reduces physical waste during design, blockchain-based supply chain tracking for material sourcing claims, and resale or rental platforms enabled by digital inventory systems. It responds to consumer and regulatory pressure on the fashion industry, one of the most resource-intensive consumer sectors, to reduce waste and improve transparency. For marketers, it is both a genuine product differentiator and an area where unverified or exaggerated sustainability claims carry real reputational and legal risk, known as greenwashing.

Sustainable fashion tech, moda endüstrisinin çevresel etkisini azaltmayı amaçlayan geri dönüştürülmüş malzeme, dijital numune ve tedarik zinciri takibi gibi teknolojileri kapsar.

## Synthetic Influence

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/synthetic-influence/

The persuasive impact of AI-generated or AI-managed digital personas, virtual influencers, and algorithmically optimized content on consumer behavior.

Synthetic Influence describes how AI-generated personas, virtual influencers, and data-optimized messaging shape consumer decisions, amplified through aesthetic design, sentiment analysis, and algorithmic targeting rather than human authenticity alone. It matters for marketers because influencers no longer need to be human, brand impact can now be predicted and engineered through language models, and smaller brands can use AI to produce high-impact campaigns without the reach of large budgets. Transparency about what is AI-generated versus real is critical to maintaining consumer trust.

Turkish: Yapay Etki Gücü. Yapay zeka tarafından oluşturulan dijital kişiliklerin, sanal etkileyicilerin ve algoritmik olarak optimize edilmiş içeriklerin tüketici davranışları üzerindeki ikna edici etkisidir.

## Synthetic Trust

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/synthetic-trust/

Trust signals (reviews, testimonials, faces, voices) that are artificially generated by AI rather than coming from real people or experiences.

Synthetic trust refers to the growing situation where the credibility cues audiences rely on, a friendly spokesperson, a glowing review, a case study photo, can now be produced entirely by AI rather than reflecting a genuine human source. As AI-generated content becomes cheap and widespread, some of it undisclosed, consumers increasingly cannot tell whether a signal of authenticity is real, which puts pressure on the trust that brand communication depends on. Marketing commentators argue the answer is transparency and real, identifiable human voices, since disclosed AI use tends to be received better than content that turns out to be AI-generated without disclosure. That raises the reputational cost for marketers of being caught using undisclosed synthetic content in reviews, testimonials, or influencer-style posts.

Synthetic trust, gerçek bir kişi veya deneyimden değil, yapay zeka tarafından üretilen güven sinyallerini (yorum, referans, yüz, ses gibi) ifade eder.

## TAP (Trusted Agent Protocol)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/tap-trusted-agent-protocol/

Trusted Agent Protocol is an open specification, co-developed by Visa and Cloudflare, that attaches cryptographically signed identity headers to AI agent web requests so a merchant can verify the request comes from a known, accountable shopping agent rather than an anonymous bot.

Status: As of October 2026: launched by Visa with Cloudflare in October 2025 with roughly a dozen launch partners, including Shopify, Stripe, Microsoft and Coinbase; by early 2026 Visa's broader agentic-commerce ecosystem, which TAP is part of, had grown past 100 partners, with Fiserv and Akamai among newer additions.

Visa and Cloudflare launched TAP on October 14, 2025, with 12 launch partners including Shopify, Stripe, Microsoft and Coinbase, and by early 2026 the protocol had more than 100 partners with a commercial launch targeted for Q1 2026. Marketers and e-commerce teams need to stop blocking legitimate AI shopping agents as bot traffic while still filtering out scrapers and fraud, and TAP is becoming the plumbing that lets agent-driven traffic reach checkout without being firewalled.

TAP, bir AI ajanının web isteğine kriptografik olarak imzalanmış kimlik başlıkları ekleyerek satıcının bu isteğin gerçek ve hesap verebilir bir alışveriş ajanından geldiğini doğrulamasını sağlayan bir protokoldür.

## Targeting

Selecting audience criteria.

Kampanyanın hangi kitleye gösterileceğini belirlemektir.

## TAT (Turnaround Time)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/tat-turnaround-time/

Response time to customer queries.

Müşteri sorularına cevap verme süresi.

## TCF 2.3 (Transparency and Consent Framework 2.3)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/tcf-2-3-transparency-and-consent-framework-2-3/

IAB Europe's updated consent-signaling standard that makes proof of vendor disclosure a mandatory, technical part of the consent string.

TCF 2.3 was released on 19 June 2025 and requires the Disclosed Vendors section of the TC string, giving technical rather than only policy-based proof that vendors were disclosed to users. The migration deadline is 28 February 2026; after that date, strings built on TCF 2.2 become technically invalid. Non-compliant ad requests then default to Google's Limited Ads mode, which industry estimates say can cut programmatic revenue by 40 to 60 percent.

TCF 2.3, satıcıların kullanıcılara gerçekten bildirildiğinin teknik kanıtını onay dizesine zorunlu kılan güncellenmiş bir onay standardıdır.

## Tech Shame

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/tech-shame/

The feeling of embarrassment or judgment an employee experiences when they have a technical problem at work, such as a video call glitch.

Tech shame describes the anxiety some employees feel about being seen as incompetent when they struggle with technology in front of colleagues, which can make them avoid speaking up in meetings or asking for help. A 2022 HP survey of 10,000 office workers, part of its "Hybrid Work: Are We There Yet?" report, found that one in five younger workers reported feeling this way, compared to about one in 25 older workers, roughly ten times the rate. For workplace and internal-communications teams, it points to a real barrier to participation and psychological safety, especially for younger employees in hybrid and remote-first teams.

Bir çalışanın, işte teknik bir sorun yaşadığında yargılanma korkusuyla hissettiği utanma duygusu.

## Textpectation

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/textpectation/

The impatience, excitement, or anxiety people feel while waiting for a reply to a digital message.

Textpectation, a blend of "text" and "expectation," describes the emotional state created by instant-messaging cues like typing indicators and read receipts, where delayed replies trigger anxiety about being ignored. It matters for marketers because consumers now hold brands to the same instant-response standard they hold friends to, especially through chatbots and social media, and slow responses are read as a sign of brand indifference. Managing this expectation is both a risk and an opportunity for building consumer trust and emotional connection.

Turkish: Textpectation (Türkçe blogda İngilizce terim aynen kullanılmış). Dijital bir mesaja yanıt beklerken hissedilen sabırsızlık, heyecan ya da kaygı halidir.

## The Algorithm Generation

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/the-algorithm-generation/

A consumer cohort defined not by age but by having its preferences and decisions actively guided by AI recommendation systems.

The Algorithm Generation refers to consumers whose content and brand choices are shaped in real time by algorithmic recommendation systems such as those on Netflix, TikTok, YouTube, and Spotify, rather than by traditional generational or cultural markers. It matters for marketers because this audience expects content to be curated specifically for them instantly, prefers curated discovery over active search, and responds better to timely micro-interactions than to broad brand messaging. Marketing has to shift from static campaigns to adaptive, learning systems built on behavioral data.

Turkish: Algoritma Kuşağı (blogda genellikle İngilizce "The Algorithm Generation" olarak kullanılmış). Yaşla değil, algoritmik öneri sistemleri tarafından yönlendirilen tercih ve kararlarla tanımlanan bir tüketici kuşağıdır.

## The Between Times

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/the-between-times/

A transitional phase in which the potential of a new technology, such as AI, is widely recognized but not yet fully understood or put to productive use.

The between times is a descriptive phrase rather than a term with a single credited coiner; it is used in technology and marketing commentary to name the awkward middle period after a breakthrough technology is announced but before organizations have built the skills, processes, and trust to use it well. Applied to AI, it captures the current moment where most companies have access to generative AI tools but have not yet redesigned workflows or measurement around them. Naming this phase helps marketers explain the gap between AI hype and AI return on investment, and it sets realistic expectations for adoption timelines.

Yeni bir teknolojinin, örneğin yapay zekanın, potansiyelinin tanınmasına rağmen henüz tam olarak anlaşılıp verimli biçimde kullanılamadığı geçiş dönemini ifade eder.

## The Fourth Industrial Revolution

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/the-fourth-industrial-revolution/

The current era of technological change in which digital, physical, and biological systems are merging through AI, robotics, and connected devices.

The term was coined by Klaus Schwab, founder of the World Economic Forum, who introduced it at the 2016 Davos meeting and expanded on it in a book of the same name. It builds on the historical framing of three prior industrial revolutions, steam and mechanization, electricity and mass production, electronics and computing, to describe today's convergence of AI, IoT, biotechnology, and automation. The concept matters to marketing teams because it frames how consumer behavior, supply chains, and media consumption are being reshaped simultaneously by multiple overlapping technologies rather than by a single innovation.

Turkish: Dördüncü Sanayi Devrimi. Yapay zeka, robotik ve bağlantılı cihazların dijital, fiziksel ve biyolojik sistemleri birleştirdiği günümüz teknolojik dönüşüm çağını tanımlayan terimdir.

## Third-Party Data

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/third-party-data/

Data collected by a party with no direct relationship to the shopper, typically aggregated across unrelated websites/apps and licensed via a data broker or exchange. Not the preferred data type in retail media given the lack of a direct data-ownership relationship, but referenced alongside first-, second-, and zero-party data.

Alışverişçiyle doğrudan ilişkisi olmayan bir tarafın, genellikle farklı sitelerden ve uygulamalardan toplayıp veri komisyoncuları aracılığıyla lisansladığı veridir. Perakende medyada ilk tercih değildir, ancak birinci, ikinci ve sıfır taraf veriyi tamamlamak için kullanılabilir.

## TOFU (Top of Funnel)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/tofu-top-of-funnel/

Content aimed at awareness for new customers.

Huninin üst aşaması (farkındalık).

## Trade Marketing

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/trade-marketing/

Retailer-brand promotional collaboration.

Marka ile perakendecinin satış noktasında birlikte yürüttüğü tanıtım çalışmalarıdır.

## Trust Dividend

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/trust-dividend/

The long-term business return, in loyalty, wallet share, and lifetime value, that comes from a brand deliberately building consumer trust.

The Trust Dividend describes the tangible payoff, increased customer loyalty, higher share of wallet, cross-selling opportunities, and higher customer lifetime value, that results from a brand consistently acting on authentic purpose and delivering trustworthy customer experiences. It reframes trust-building as a measurable business driver rather than a soft or optional value, although linking trust to financial outcomes remains a real measurement challenge for CFOs and marketers alike. It also ties responsible, transparent use of AI and customer data directly to whether that trust is gained or lost.

Turkish: Güven Temettüsü. Bir markanın bilinçli olarak güven inşa etmesi sonucunda elde ettiği sadakat, cüzdan payı ve müşteri yaşam boyu değeri artışı gibi uzun vadeli iş getirisidir.

## Uberisation

Category: Technology Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/uberisation/

The disruption of a traditional service industry by digital platforms that connect customers and providers directly, bypassing established intermediaries.

The term derives from Uber, whose app-based, on-demand ride-hailing model became shorthand for a broader pattern: digital platforms matching supply and demand in real time without the fixed schedules, ownership structures, or intermediaries of the industry they replace. The word gained particular traction in France before spreading internationally. Uberisation matters to marketers because it signals which categories are vulnerable to platform disruption and reframes competitive strategy around access and convenience rather than ownership.

Turkish: Uberleşme. Dijital platformların, müşteri ve hizmet sağlayıcıyı doğrudan buluşturarak geleneksel aracıları devre dışı bırakmasıyla bir sektörün dönüşmesini ifade eder.

## UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol)

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ucp-universal-commerce-protocol/

An open-source standard that gives AI agents and merchant stores a shared language so shoppers can add items to cart from within Search, Gemini, YouTube, or Gmail.

Status: As of September 2026: announced by Google in January 2026 at NRF, co-developed with Shopify, Etsy, Wayfair, Target and Walmart.

UCP is an open-source standard Google released in January 2026, co-developed with Shopify, Etsy, Wayfair, Target, and Walmart. It gives AI agents and merchant stores a common language so a shopper can add a product to a cart from inside Search, Gemini, YouTube, or Gmail. It is compatible with AP2 for payments and with A2A and MCP for agent communication, positioning it as Google's flagship answer to agentic shopping. Retail and performance marketers in Google-Ads-heavy markets need to know what merchant integration it requires.

UCP, alışveriş yapanların Search, Gemini, YouTube veya Gmail içinden sepete ürün eklemesini sağlayan ortak bir standarttır.

## UGC (User-Generated Content)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms

Content created by users (comments, posts, videos).

## UGR (User-Generated Reviews)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ugr-user-generated-reviews/

Reviews created by users that build trust in brands.

Kullanıcıların yazdığı, markaya güven oluşturan değerlendirmelerdir.

## UGS (User-Generated Stories)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ugs-user-generated-stories/

Stories created by users enhancing brand authenticity.

Kullanıcıların oluşturduğu, markanın samimiyetini güçlendiren hikayelerdir.

## UID2 (Unified ID 2.0)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/uid2-unified-id-2-0/

An open-source, privacy-first identity framework that turns first-party data such as an email into a hashed identifier for targeted advertising without third-party cookies.

Status: As of September 2026: in active use. Google retired its Privacy Sandbox APIs in October 2025, which keeps first-party identity solutions like UID2 relevant.

UID2 is an open-source identity framework, championed by The Trade Desk, that converts first-party data such as an email address into a hashed and salted identifier so advertisers can target without third-party cookies. The technology itself predates the last two years, but it became the de facto industry standard identity solution through 2025 and 2026, after Google abandoned its Privacy Sandbox cookie-replacement effort in late 2025. New adopters in that period include Roku, Experian, and Perion. Any programmatic buy made outside walled gardens now runs into UID2 as the leading open-web alternative.

UID2, üçüncü taraf çerez kullanmadan hedefli reklam yapabilmek için e-posta gibi birinci taraf veriyi karma bir kimliğe dönüştürür.

## Unique Reach

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/unique-reach/

Distinct individuals exposed.

Reklamı gören tekil kişi sayısıdır.

## Upsell

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/upsell/

Driving shoppers to higher-value products.

Alışverişçiyi daha yüksek değerli bir ürüne yönlendirmektir.

## UX (User Experience)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/ux-user-experience/

Overall experience of a user with a product or service.

Kullanıcının bir ürün ya da hizmetle yaşadığı deneyimin bütünüdür.

## Vibe Marketing

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/vibe-marketing/

A marketing workflow in which a marketer describes the desired outcome, tone and audience in plain language, and AI tools handle the execution: copy, landing pages, ad variants and segmentation.

Vibe marketing takes its name from vibe coding, a term Andrej Karpathy coined in February 2025 for writing software by describing intent to an AI model rather than writing code by hand. Marketers adapted the idea through 2025 and 2026: instead of briefing a creative team or building assets by hand, a marketer states the goal and feel of a campaign in natural language, and AI tools generate and iterate the actual deliverables. eMarketer and Advertising Week both documented the practice spreading through small and mid-sized marketing teams in 2026, and MarTech noted related search interest growing sharply over the same period.

Vibe marketing, bir pazarlamacının istenen sonucu, tonu ve hedef kitleyi sade bir dille tarif etmesi, metin, açılış sayfası, reklam varyasyonu ve segmentasyon gibi uygulama işini ise yapay zeka araçlarının üstlenmesidir.

## View-Through Conversion

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/view-through-conversion/

Conversion after seeing (but not clicking) an ad.

Reklamı tıklamadan yalnızca gördükten sonra gerçekleşen dönüşümdür.

## Viewability

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/viewability/

A metric tracking whether an ad unit was visibly rendered on a screen according to industry standards (whether an ad was actually visible). (e.g., MRC/IAB standard: at least 50% of ad pixels in view for less than 1 continuous second for display, or less than 2 seconds for video).

Bir reklamın sektör standartlarına göre gerçekten ekranda görülüp görülmediğini ölçen metriktir; MRC/IAB standardına göre reklamın en az yüzde 50'si görüntülü reklamda 1 saniye, videoda 2 saniye ekranda kalmalıdır.

## Viewability

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/viewability-2/

Whether an ad was actually visible.

Bir reklamın gerçekten görülüp görülmediğini ifade eder.

## VTR (View-Through Rate)

Category: Digital Marketing Acronyms
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/vtr-view-through-rate/

Users who convert later after viewing ads without immediate clicking.

Reklam sonrası gecikmeli dönüşüm oranı.

## Vulnerability in Leadership

Category: Leadership & Organization
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/vulnerability-in-leadership/

A leadership style that values openness about uncertainty, mistakes, and personal limitations as a way to build trust and stronger teams.

Vulnerability in leadership draws on research popularized by writers such as Brene Brown, arguing that leaders who acknowledge uncertainty or admit mistakes build more trust and psychological safety than leaders who project constant confidence. Applied to corporate leadership, it means being transparent about what a leader does not know, inviting challenge, and treating setbacks as shared learning rather than something to hide. Teams led with more openness tend to surface problems earlier and take more creative risks, since employees are less afraid of being blamed for honest failure, which is why the concept matters to marketers and executives.

Liderlerin belirsizlik, hata ve kişisel sınırlar konusunda açık olmasının güven ve daha güçlü ekipler oluşturduğunu savunan bir liderlik yaklaşımıdır.

## Walled Garden

Category: Retail Media
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/walled-garden/

Closed ecosystem with proprietary data.

Verisini kendi içinde tutan, dışarıya kapalı reklam ekosistemidir; Google, Meta ve Amazon gibi.

## Webtoon

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/webtoon/

A mobile-native, vertically scrolled digital comic format, originating in South Korea, published in short serialized episodes.

A Webtoon is a digital comic designed for vertical scrolling on mobile devices, delivered in short episodes (roughly 2-5 minutes to read) with interactive features like comments and likes. It matters for marketers because webtoons function as branded storytelling platforms and loyalty tools, offering character-driven campaign opportunities, transmedia extensions into games, music, and film, and a direct channel to reach Gen Z and Millennial audiences who show high loyalty and emotional investment in the format.

Turkish: Webtoon (Türkçe blogda İngilizce terim aynen kullanılmış). Güney Kore kökenli, mobil cihazlar için tasarlanmış, dikey kaydırmalı ve kısa bölümler halinde yayınlanan dijital çizgi roman formatıdır.

## Workflow-First AI

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/workflow-first-ai/

An approach where AI capabilities are integrated into a single end-to-end workflow instead of being used as separate, manually connected point tools.

Workflow-First AI moves businesses away from using isolated AI tools for single tasks (like image recognition or translation) that require manual integration, toward unified systems that pass data and context automatically between stages of a process. It matters for marketers and other business functions because it reduces the time and error associated with manually stitching together point solutions, and enables contextual understanding and real-time adaptation across an entire process such as e-commerce, healthcare, finance, or manufacturing operations.

Yapay zeka yeteneklerinin, elle birleştirilen ayrı araçlar yerine tek bir uçtan uca iş akışında entegre edildiği bir yaklaşımdır.

## Workslop

Category: AI & Marketing Concepts
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/workslop/

AI-generated work output that looks polished and professional but is incomplete, irrelevant, or lacks real value, and creates hidden extra work for others.

Workslop refers to AI outputs that appear finished and competent on the surface but are decontextualized, incomplete, or unhelpful, forcing colleagues down the workflow to spend time fixing, completing, or interpreting them. It matters for marketers because it directly damages brand trust when off-brand or context-poor AI content reaches consumers, quietly lowers real campaign ROI behind a surface appearance of productivity, and drains team creative capacity as people correct AI mistakes instead of producing original work. The fix is clear AI usage standards, prompt governance, and quality metrics.

Turkish: Workslop (Türkçe blogda İngilizce terim aynen kullanılmış). Görünüşte kaliteli ama gerçekte eksik, alakasız ya da değer katmayan, başkalarına ek iş yükü yaratan yapay zeka çıktılarıdır.

Reklam sistemlerinin kullandığı, ürün bilgilerini düzenli biçimde taşıyan katalog dosyasıdır.

Data intentionally shared by consumers.

Tüketicinin tercihlerini ve niyetini markayla bilerek ve isteyerek paylaştığı veridir.

## Zoom Fatigue

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/zoom-fatigue/

The exhaustion and burnout caused by spending long periods on video calls, first widely reported during the COVID-19 pandemic.

Zoom fatigue describes the mental tiredness people experience after back-to-back video meetings, a phenomenon that became widespread once remote work pushed millions of people into videoconferencing during 2020. Stanford Communication Professor Jeremy Bailenson, director of the university's Virtual Human Interaction Lab, published a February 2021 article in Technology, Mind, and Behavior arguing for four likely causes, which he framed as arguments rather than settled findings: forced close-up eye contact, the cognitive effort of exaggerating nonverbal cues like nodding, the unnatural experience of seeing your own face on screen, and reduced physical mobility during calls. The term mattered enough to shape a lasting shift toward shorter meetings, asynchronous updates, and camera-optional culture inside organizations, all of which affect how marketers and internal communicators design internal and customer-facing video content.

Zoom fatigue, özellikle COVID-19 döneminde yaygınlaşan, uzun süreli görüntülü görüşmelerin yol açtığı zihinsel yorgunluk ve tükenmişliktir.

## Zoombombing

Category: Consumer & Culture Trends
URL: https://mma-academy-dictionary.vercel.app/term/zoombombing/

The act of an uninvited person disrupting a video call, often by displaying offensive images or language, by exploiting weak meeting security.

Zoombombing blends the platform name Zoom with photobombing and describes trolls or hackers hijacking video meetings, most often by guessing or sharing unprotected meeting links, to broadcast pornographic, hateful, or otherwise disruptive content. The term spread in mid-March 2020 as videoconferencing use exploded during COVID-19 lockdowns, and the US FBI issued a public warning about the practice in early April 2020 after receiving multiple reports of hijacked school and business calls. It pointed marketers and event organizers to a basic security need, waiting rooms, passwords, and controlled screen-sharing, for any brand webinar, town hall, or virtual event that used public or easily shared join links.

Zoombombing, davetsiz bir kişinin zayıf toplantı güvenliğinden yararlanarak bir görüntülü görüşmeyi, genellikle rahatsız edici görüntü veya söylemlerle, kesintiye uğratmasıdır.
